# MEMORIA PERSISTENTE STRUTTURATA (FASE 2B)
# ============================================================================

def _format_memory_row(item: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Deserializza i metadati JSON della memoria."""
    raw = item.get("metadata_json")
    if raw:
        try:
            item["metadata"] = json.loads(raw)
        except Exception:
            item["metadata"] = {}
    else:
        item["metadata"] = {}
    return item


def _sanitize_fts_query(q: str) -> str:
    """Sanitizza e prepara la query FTS5 per evitare errori di sintassi su caratteri speciali."""
    tokens = re.findall(r"[\w]+", q, re.UNICODE)
    if not tokens:
        return ""
    return " ".join(f'"{t}"*' for t in tokens)


def save_memory(
    memory_type: str,
    content: str,
    project_id: str = "default",
    provenance_type: str = "manual",
    provenance_id: str | None = None,
    confidence: float = 1.0,
    status: str = "active",
    scope: str = "global",
    owner_bot_id: str | None = None,
    metadata: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
    memory_id: str | None = None,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Salva una memoria persistente strutturata."""
    if not memory_id:
        memory_id = f"mem_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:12]}"
    meta_json = json.dumps(metadata or {})
    conn = get_connection()
    try:
        with conn:
            conn.execute(
                """
                INSERT INTO memories (
                    id, memory_type, content, project_id, provenance_type, provenance_id,
                    confidence, status, scope, owner_bot_id, metadata_json, created_at, updated_at
                )
                VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP);
                """,
                (
                    memory_id, memory_type, content.strip(), project_id, provenance_type,
                    provenance_id, confidence, status, scope, owner_bot_id, meta_json
                ),
            )
        return get_memory(memory_id) or {
            "id": memory_id,
            "memory_type": memory_type,
            "content": content.strip(),
            "project_id": project_id,
            "confidence": confidence,
            "status": status,
            "scope": scope,
        }
    finally:
        conn.close()


def get_memory(memory_id: str) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
    """Recupera una memoria per ID."""
    conn = get_connection()
    try:
        cursor = conn.execute("SELECT * FROM memories WHERE id = ?;", (memory_id,))
        row = cursor.fetchone()
        return _format_memory_row(dict(row)) if row else None
    finally:
        conn.close()


def get_memories(
    project_id: str | None = None,
    memory_type: str | None = None,
    status: str = "active",
    scope: str | None = None,
    owner_bot_id: str | None = None,
    limit: int = 50,
) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    """Elenca le memorie con filtri opzionali su progetto, tipo, stato e visibilità."""
    conn = get_connection()
    try:
        query = "SELECT * FROM memories WHERE 1=1"
        params: list[Any] = []
        if status:
            query += " AND status = ?"
            params.append(status)
        if project_id:
            query += " AND (project_id = ? OR scope = 'global')"
            params.append(project_id)
        if memory_type:
            query += " AND memory_type = ?"
            params.append(memory_type)
        if scope:
            query += " AND scope = ?"
            params.append(scope)
        if owner_bot_id:
            query += " AND (owner_bot_id IS NULL OR owner_bot_id = ?)"
            params.append(owner_bot_id)

        query += " ORDER BY updated_at DESC, confidence DESC LIMIT ?;"
        params.append(limit)

        cursor = conn.execute(query, params)
        return [_format_memory_row(dict(r)) for r in cursor.fetchall()]
    finally:
        conn.close()


def search_memories_fts(
    query_str: str,
    project_id: str | None = None,
    scope: str | None = None,
    limit: int = 20,
) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    """Ricerca full-text nativa FTS5 con ranking bm25."""
    clean_fts = _sanitize_fts_query(query_str)
    if not clean_fts:
        return []

    conn = get_connection()
    try:
        query = """
            SELECT m.*, bm25(memories_fts) as bm25_score
            FROM memories_fts fts
            JOIN memories m ON m.id = fts.id
            WHERE memories_fts MATCH ?
              AND m.status = 'active'
        """
        params: list[Any] = [clean_fts]
        if project_id:
            query += " AND (m.project_id = ? OR m.scope = 'global')"
            params.append(project_id)
        if scope:
            query += " AND m.scope = ?"
            params.append(scope)

        query += " ORDER BY bm25_score ASC LIMIT ?;"
        params.append(limit)

        cursor = conn.execute(query, params)
        return [_format_memory_row(dict(r)) for r in cursor.fetchall()]
    finally:
        conn.close()


def update_memory(
    memory_id: str,
    content: str | None = None,
    confidence: float | None = None,
    status: str | None = None,
    metadata: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
    project_id: str | None = None,
    scope: str | None = None,
) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
    """Aggiorna i campi di una memoria esistente."""
    conn = get_connection()
    try:
        fields = ["updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP"]
        params = []
        if content is not None:
            fields.append("content = ?")
            params.append(content.strip())
        if confidence is not None:
            fields.append("confidence = ?")
            params.append(confidence)
        if status is not None:
            fields.append("status = ?")
            params.append(status)
        if metadata is not None:
            fields.append("metadata_json = ?")
            params.append(json.dumps(metadata))
        if project_id is not None:
            fields.append("project_id = ?")
            params.append(project_id)
        if scope is not None:
            fields.append("scope = ?")
            params.append(scope)

        query = f"UPDATE memories SET {', '.join(fields)} WHERE id = ?;"
        params.append(memory_id)

        with conn:
            conn.execute(query, params)
        return get_memory(memory_id)
    finally:
        conn.close()


def delete_memory(memory_id: str, hard_delete: bool = False) -> bool:
    """Elimina una memoria (soft delete o hard delete). Rimuove automaticamente da FTS5."""
    conn = get_connection()
    try:
        with conn:
            if hard_delete:
                cursor = conn.execute("DELETE FROM memories WHERE id = ?;", (memory_id,))
                conn.execute("DELETE FROM memories_fts WHERE id = ?;", (memory_id,))
                return cursor.rowcount == 1
            else:
                cursor = conn.execute(
                    "UPDATE memories SET status = 'deleted', updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = ?;",
                    (memory_id,),
                )
                return cursor.rowcount == 1
    finally:
        conn.close()


def get_memory_settings() -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Recupera le impostazioni di memorizzazione."""
    conn = get_connection()
    try:
        cursor = conn.execute("SELECT key, value_json FROM memory_settings;")
        res = {"auto_memory_enabled": True, "max_context_budget": 2500}
        for row in cursor.fetchall():
            try:
                res[row["key"]] = json.loads(row["value_json"])
            except Exception:
                res[row["key"]] = row["value_json"]
        return res
    finally:
        conn.close()


def save_memory_setting(key: str, value: Any) -> None:
    """Salva una singola impostazione di memorizzazione."""
    conn = get_connection()
    try:
        with conn:
            conn.execute(
                """
                INSERT INTO memory_settings (key, value_json, updated_at)
                VALUES (?, ?, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
                ON CONFLICT(key) DO UPDATE SET value_json = excluded.value_json, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP;
                """,
                (key, json.dumps(value)),
            )
    finally:
        conn.close()


# ============================================================================
# FASE 2C: AUTONOMIA PROGRAMMATA, SCHEDULER, CONSUMI E NOTIFICHE
# ============================================================================

def _format_job_row(row: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Helper per formattare una riga scheduled_jobs."""
    item = dict(row)
    if item.get("schedule_config_json"):
        try:
            item["schedule_config"] = json.loads(item["schedule_config_json"])
        except Exception:
            item["schedule_config"] = {}
    else:
        item["schedule_config"] = {}
    return item


def create_scheduled_job(
    name: str,
    prompt: str,
    schedule_type: str,
    schedule_config: dict[str, Any],
    chat_id: str,
    target_bot_id: str = "chief",
    project_id: str = "default",
    timezone: str = "UTC",
    missed_job_policy: str = "skip",
    next_run_at: str | None = None,
    job_id: str | None = None,
    description: str | None = None,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Crea una nuova attività programmata nel database."""
    if not job_id:
        job_id = f"job_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:12]}"
    config_json = json.dumps(schedule_config)

    conn = get_connection()
    try:
        with conn:
            conn.execute(
                """
                INSERT INTO scheduled_jobs (
                    id, name, description, prompt, target_bot_id, chat_id, project_id,
                    schedule_type, schedule_config_json, timezone, status, next_run_at,
                    missed_job_policy, created_at, updated_at
                ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, 'active', ?, ?, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP);
                """,
                (
                    job_id,
                    name.strip(),
                    description.strip() if description else "",
                    prompt.strip(),
                    target_bot_id.strip(),
                    chat_id.strip(),
                    project_id.strip(),
                    schedule_type.strip(),
                    config_json,
                    timezone.strip(),
                    next_run_at,
                    missed_job_policy.strip(),
                ),
            )
        job = get_scheduled_job(job_id)
        if not job:
            raise RuntimeError(f"Impossibile creare il job {job_id}")
        return job
    finally:
        conn.close()


def get_scheduled_job(job_id: str) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
    """Recupera una singola attività programmata."""
    conn = get_connection()
    try:
        cursor = conn.execute(
            """
            SELECT id, name, description, prompt, target_bot_id, chat_id, project_id,
                   schedule_type, schedule_config_json, timezone, status, next_run_at,
                   last_run_at, missed_job_policy, created_at, updated_at
            FROM scheduled_jobs
            WHERE id = ?;
            """,
            (job_id,),
        )
        row = cursor.fetchone()
        return _format_job_row(dict(row)) if row else None
    finally:
        conn.close()


def get_scheduled_jobs(
    project_id: str | None = None,
    status: str | None = None,
) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    """Elenca le attività programmate con filtri opzionali."""
    conn = get_connection()
    try:
        query = (
            "SELECT id, name, description, prompt, target_bot_id, chat_id, project_id, "
            "schedule_type, schedule_config_json, timezone, status, next_run_at, "
            "last_run_at, missed_job_policy, created_at, updated_at "
            "FROM scheduled_jobs WHERE 1=1"
        )
        params: list[Any] = []
        if project_id:
            query += " AND project_id = ?"
            params.append(project_id)
        if status:
            query += " AND status = ?"
            params.append(status)
        query += " ORDER BY created_at DESC;"

        cursor = conn.execute(query, params)
        return [_format_job_row(dict(r)) for r in cursor.fetchall()]
    finally:
        conn.close()


def update_scheduled_job(
    job_id: str,
    name: str | None = None,
    description: str | None = None,
    prompt: str | None = None,
    target_bot_id: str | None = None,
    schedule_type: str | None = None,
    schedule_config: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
    timezone: str | None = None,
    status: str | None = None,
    next_run_at: str | None = None,
    last_run_at: str | None = None,
    missed_job_policy: str | None = None,
) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
    """Aggiorna campi specifici di un'attività programmata."""
    conn = get_connection()
    try:
        fields = ["updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP"]
        params: list[Any] = []
        if name is not None:
            fields.append("name = ?")
            params.append(name.strip())
        if description is not None:
            fields.append("description = ?")
            params.append(description.strip())
        if prompt is not None:
            fields.append("prompt = ?")
            params.append(prompt.strip())
        if target_bot_id is not None:
            fields.append("target_bot_id = ?")
            params.append(target_bot_id.strip())
        if schedule_type is not None:
            fields.append("schedule_type = ?")
            params.append(schedule_type.strip())
        if schedule_config is not None:
            fields.append("schedule_config_json = ?")
            params.append(json.dumps(schedule_config))
        if timezone is not None:
            fields.append("timezone = ?")
            params.append(timezone.strip())
        if status is not None:
            fields.append("status = ?")
            params.append(status.strip())
        if next_run_at is not None:
            fields.append("next_run_at = ?")
            params.append(next_run_at)
        if last_run_at is not None:
            fields.append("last_run_at = ?")
            params.append(last_run_at)
        if missed_job_policy is not None:
            fields.append("missed_job_policy = ?")
            params.append(missed_job_policy.strip())

        query = f"UPDATE scheduled_jobs SET {', '.join(fields)} WHERE id = ?;"
        params.append(job_id)

        with conn:
            conn.execute(query, params)
        return get_scheduled_job(job_id)
    finally:
        conn.close()


def delete_scheduled_job(job_id: str) -> bool:
    """Elimina definitivamente un'attività programmata e le sue esecuzioni."""
    conn = get_connection()
    try:
        with conn:
            cursor = conn.execute("DELETE FROM scheduled_jobs WHERE id = ?;", (job_id,))
            return cursor.rowcount == 1
    finally:
        conn.close()


def reserve_job_for_execution_atomic(
    job_id: str,
    expected_next_run: str | None,
    new_next_run: str | None,
    new_status: str = "active",
) -> bool:
    """
    Prenota atomicamente un job per l'esecuzione, aggiornando next_run_at e last_run_at.
    Restituisce True solo se la riga è stata aggiornata esattamente da questa chiamata,
    prevenendo doppie esecuzioni concorrenti su SQLite.
    """
    conn = get_connection()
    try:
        with conn:
            if expected_next_run is None:
                cursor = conn.execute(
                    """
                    UPDATE scheduled_jobs
                    SET next_run_at = ?, last_run_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, status = ?, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
                    WHERE id = ? AND status = 'active' AND next_run_at IS NULL;
                    """,
                    (new_next_run, new_status, job_id),
                )
            else:
                cursor = conn.execute(
                    """
                    UPDATE scheduled_jobs
                    SET next_run_at = ?, last_run_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, status = ?, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
                    WHERE id = ? AND status = 'active' AND next_run_at = ?;
                    """,
                    (new_next_run, new_status, job_id, expected_next_run),
                )
            return cursor.rowcount == 1
    finally:
        conn.close()


def create_job_execution(
    job_id: str,
    scheduled_for: str,
    task_id: str | None = None,
    status: str = "running",
    error_message: str | None = None,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Crea una riga nella cronologia delle esecuzioni."""
    exec_id = f"exec_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:12]}"
    conn = get_connection()
    try:
        with conn:
            conn.execute(
                """
                INSERT INTO job_executions (
                    id, job_id, scheduled_for, executed_at, task_id, status, error_message, duration_ms, created_at
                ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, ?, ?, ?, 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP);
                """,
                (exec_id, job_id, scheduled_for, task_id, status, error_message),
            )
        return {
            "id": exec_id,
            "job_id": job_id,
            "scheduled_for": scheduled_for,
            "task_id": task_id,
            "status": status,
            "error_message": error_message,
            "duration_ms": 0,
        }
    finally:
        conn.close()


def update_job_execution(
    execution_id: str,
    status: str,
    error_message: str | None = None,
    duration_ms: int = 0,
    task_id: str | None = None,
) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
    """Aggiorna lo stato e i risultati di un'esecuzione registrata."""
    conn = get_connection()
    try:
        fields = ["status = ?", "duration_ms = ?"]
        params: list[Any] = [status, duration_ms]
        if error_message is not None:
            fields.append("error_message = ?")
            params.append(error_message)
        if task_id is not None:
            fields.append("task_id = ?")
            params.append(task_id)

        query = f"UPDATE job_executions SET {', '.join(fields)} WHERE id = ?;"
        params.append(execution_id)

        with conn:
            conn.execute(query, params)

        cursor = conn.execute("SELECT * FROM job_executions WHERE id = ?;", (execution_id,))
        row = cursor.fetchone()
        return dict(row) if row else None
    finally:
        conn.close()

# --- CONSUMI & QUOTE ---

def record_usage(
    model_name: str,
    task_id: str | None = None,
    chat_id: str | None = None,
    job_id: str | None = None,
    input_tokens: int | None = None,
    output_tokens: int | None = None,
    estimated_cost_usd: float = 0.0,
    duration_ms: int = 0,
    is_estimated: int = 1,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Registra una transazione di utilizzo del modello (senza inventare token se non forniti)."""
    usage_id = f"usg_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:12]}"
    total_tokens = None
    if input_tokens is not None and output_tokens is not None:
        total_tokens = input_tokens + output_tokens

    conn = get_connection()
    try:
        with conn:
            conn.execute(
                """
                INSERT INTO usage_records (
                    id, timestamp, model_name, task_id, chat_id, job_id,
                    input_tokens, output_tokens, total_tokens, estimated_cost_usd,
                    is_estimated, duration_ms
                ) VALUES (?, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?);
                """,
                (
                    usage_id,
                    model_name,
                    task_id,
                    chat_id,
                    job_id,
                    input_tokens,
                    output_tokens,
                    total_tokens,
                    estimated_cost_usd,
                    is_estimated,
                    duration_ms,
                ),
            )
        return {
            "id": usage_id,
            "model_name": model_name,
            "task_id": task_id,
            "chat_id": chat_id,
            "job_id": job_id,
            "input_tokens": input_tokens,
            "output_tokens": output_tokens,
            "total_tokens": total_tokens,
            "estimated_cost_usd": estimated_cost_usd,
            "is_estimated": is_estimated,
        }
    finally:
        conn.close()


def get_usage_summary(
    days: int = 1,
    chat_id: str | None = None,
    task_id: str | None = None,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Calcola il riassunto consumi per giornata, task o chat."""
    conn = get_connection()
    try:
        # Conteggio richieste oggi
        cursor = conn.execute(
            """
            SELECT COUNT(*) AS req_count,
                   SUM(COALESCE(input_tokens, 0)) AS in_tokens,
                   SUM(COALESCE(output_tokens, 0)) AS out_tokens,
                   SUM(COALESCE(total_tokens, 0)) AS tot_tokens,
                   SUM(COALESCE(estimated_cost_usd, 0.0)) AS tot_cost
            FROM usage_records
            WHERE timestamp >= datetime('now', '-' || ? || ' day');
            """,
            (days,),
        )
        row = cursor.fetchone()
        tot_requests = (row["req_count"] or 0) if row else 0
        in_tokens = (row["in_tokens"] or 0) if row else 0
        out_tokens = (row["out_tokens"] or 0) if row else 0
        tot_tokens = (row["tot_tokens"] or 0) if row else 0
        tot_cost = float(row["tot_cost"] or 0.0) if row else 0.0

        # Raggruppamento per modello
        cursor_mod = conn.execute(
            """
            SELECT model_name, COUNT(*) AS count,
                   SUM(COALESCE(total_tokens, 0)) AS tokens,
                   SUM(COALESCE(estimated_cost_usd, 0.0)) AS cost
            FROM usage_records
            WHERE timestamp >= datetime('now', '-' || ? || ' day')
            GROUP BY model_name;
            """,
            (days,),
        )
        by_model = [dict(r) for r in cursor_mod.fetchall()]

        # Se richiesto per uno specifico task
        task_usage = None
        if task_id:
            cursor_task = conn.execute(
                """
                SELECT COUNT(*) AS count,
                       SUM(COALESCE(total_tokens, 0)) AS tokens,
                       SUM(COALESCE(estimated_cost_usd, 0.0)) AS cost
                FROM usage_records WHERE task_id = ?;
                """,
                (task_id,),
            )
            r_t = cursor_task.fetchone()
            task_usage = {
                "requests": r_t["count"] if r_t else 0,
                "tokens": r_t["tokens"] if r_t else 0,
                "cost": r_t["cost"] if r_t else 0.0,
            }

        return {
            "period_days": days,
            "requests_count": tot_requests,
            "input_tokens": in_tokens,
            "output_tokens": out_tokens,
            "total_tokens": tot_tokens,
            "estimated_cost_usd": round(tot_cost, 6),
            "is_estimate_notice": "Stima puramente indicativa dei consumi, non costituisce fatturazione reale.",
            "by_model": by_model,
            "task_usage": task_usage,
        }
    finally:
        conn.close()

    """Recupera le quote e limiti configurati."""
    conn = get_connection()
    try:
        cursor = conn.execute("SELECT key, value_json FROM usage_limits;")

            "max_requests_daily": 200,
            "max_concurrent_tasks": 3,
            "max_execution_seconds_per_task": 120,
            "max_daily_tokens": 500000,
        }
        for row in cursor.fetchall():
            try:
                res[row["key"]] = json.loads(row["value_json"])
            except Exception:
                res[row["key"]] = row["value_json"]
        return res
    finally:
        conn.close()

# --- NOTIFICHE LOCALI ---

def create_notification(
    category: str,
    title: str,
    message: str,
    related_id: str | None = None,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Crea una notifica locale persistente."""
    notif_id = f"notif_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:12]}"
    conn = get_connection()
    try:
        with conn:
            conn.execute(
                """
                INSERT INTO notifications (id, category, title, message, related_id, is_read, created_at)
                VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP);
                """,
                (notif_id, category.strip(), title.strip(), message.strip(), related_id),
            )
        return {
            "id": notif_id,
            "category": category,
            "title": title,
            "message": message,
            "related_id": related_id,
            "is_read": 0,
        }
    finally:
        conn.close()


def get_notifications(
    limit: int = 50,
    unread_only: bool = False,
) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    """Elenca le notifiche locali."""
    conn = get_connection()
    try:
        if unread_only:
            cursor = conn.execute(
                """
                SELECT id, category, title, message, related_id, is_read, created_at
                FROM notifications
                WHERE is_read = 0
                ORDER BY created_at DESC
                LIMIT ?;
                """,
                (limit,),
            )
        else:
            cursor = conn.execute(
                """
                SELECT id, category, title, message, related_id, is_read, created_at
                FROM notifications
                ORDER BY created_at DESC
                LIMIT ?;
                """,
                (limit,),
            )
        return [dict(r) for r in cursor.fetchall()]
    finally:
        conn.close()


def mark_notification_read(notification_id: str) -> bool:
    """Segna una notifica come letta."""
    conn = get_connection()
    try:
        with conn:
            cursor = conn.execute(
                "UPDATE notifications SET is_read = 1 WHERE id = ?;",
                (notification_id,),
            )
            return cursor.rowcount == 1
    finally:
        conn.close()


def mark_all_notifications_read() -> int:
    """Segna tutte le notifiche come lette."""
    conn = get_connection()
    try:
        with conn:
            cursor = conn.execute("UPDATE notifications SET is_read = 1 WHERE is_read = 0;")
            return cursor.rowcount
    finally:
        conn.close()


def get_app_setting(key: str, default: Any = None) -> Any:
    """Recupera un'impostazione generale dell'applicazione."""
    conn = get_connection()
    try:
        cur = conn.execute("SELECT value_json FROM app_settings WHERE key = ?;", (key,))
        row = cur.fetchone()
        if row:
            return json.loads(row["value_json"])
        return default
    except Exception:
        return default
    finally:
        conn.close()


def save_app_setting(key: str, value: Any) -> None:
    """Salva o aggiorna un'impostazione generale dell'applicazione."""
    conn = get_connection()
    try:
        with conn:
            conn.execute(
                """
                INSERT INTO app_settings (key, value_json, updated_at)
                VALUES (?, ?, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
                ON CONFLICT(key) DO UPDATE SET value_json = excluded.value_json, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP;
                """,
                (key, json.dumps(value)),
            )
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"[DB Error] save_app_setting: {e}")
    finally:
        conn.close()


# Automatically initialize and seed database on import
init_db()
seed_db()


// === FILE: backend\fast_path_router.py ===

"""
CoworkerOS Fast Path Router (Fase 4)
Router deterministico per richieste semplici, esplicite e non ambigue.
Esegue direttamente i tool backend in sola lettura senza overhead LLM (<150ms).
Bypassa immediatamente verso Qwen per compiti che richiedono ragionamento, sintesi, interpretazione o multi-step.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import re
import time
from typing import Any, Dict, Optional, Tuple

import tools_os
from local_model_manager import local_model_mgr, get_system_ram_info, get_system_power_info


# Parole chiave che indicano necessità di ragionamento, analisi, sintesi o interpretazione
REASONING_VERBS = (
    "analizza", "spiega", "perché", "perche", "riassumi", "sintetizza", "confronta",
    "correggi", "cosa ne pensi", "cosa significa", "valuta", "consiglia", "opinione",
    "elabora", "commenta", "interpreta", "dimmi qual è la parola chiave",
    "parola chiave segreta", "trova il significato", "pianifica", "progetta",
    "secondo te", "come mai", "istruzioni", "cosa c'è", "cosa ce", "dimmi cosa", "estrai"
)

# Parole chiave che indicano modifiche fisiche o distruttive (NON ammesse in fast path)
MUTATION_KEYWORDS = (
    "scrivi", "elimina", "cancella", "rimuovi", "sposta", "crea", "sovrascrivi",
    "modifica", "clicca", "premi", "incolla", "apri app", "avvia"
)


class FastPathRouter:
    """Valuta le richieste in modo deterministico e sicuro."""

    @staticmethod
    def is_fast_path_candidate(text: str) -> bool:
        t_clean = text.strip().lower()
        if not t_clean or len(t_clean) > 220:
            return False

        # Se ci sono richieste di interpretazione o verbi di ragionamento -> Qwen
        if any(v in t_clean for v in REASONING_VERBS):
            return False

        # Se ci sono azioni di scrittura o modifiche -> human-in-the-loop / Qwen
        if any(m in t_clean for m in MUTATION_KEYWORDS):
            return False

        # Se sono presenti connettori multi-step ("poi", "quindi", "dopo", "e poi", "inoltre") -> Qwen
        if any(conn in t_clean for conn in (" poi ", " e poi ", " quindi ", " successivamente ", " dopodiché ", " dopodiche ")):
            return False

        return True

    @classmethod
    def try_route(cls, text: str) -> Optional[Tuple[str, Dict[str, Any]]]:
        """
        Analizza la richiesta deterministica.
        Se c'è corrispondenza univoca, restituisce (action_type, params).
        Altrimenti restituisce None.
        """
        if not cls.is_fast_path_candidate(text):
            return None

        t = text.strip().lower()
        # Rimuove punteggiatura finale
        t_norm = re.sub(r"[?!.]+$", "", t).strip()

        # 1. Elenco finestre aperte
        if re.search(r"^(?:elenca|mostra|quali sono le|lista delle?|quali app sono|visualizza)\s+(?:le\s+)?finestre(?:\s+aperte|\s+attive)?(?:\s+sul\s+desktop)?$", t_norm):
            return ("list_windows", {})
        if t_norm in ("finestre aperte", "finestre attive", "mostrami le finestre", "mostra finestre", "elenca finestre", "elenca le finestre"):
            return ("list_windows", {})

        # 2. Stato CoworkerOS / Sistema / RAM / Modello
        if re.search(r"^(?:stato|status)\s+(?:del\s+sistema|di\s+coworkeros|di\s+qwen|del\s+modello|della\s+ram)$", t_norm):
            return ("system_status", {})
        if t_norm in ("quanta ram è libera", "quanta ram abbiamo", "ram disponibile", "stato modello", "stato sistema", "stato coworkerOS", "stato di coworkerOS"):
            return ("system_status", {})

        # 3. Ricerca di un file per nome
        # Es: "cerca il file sample_doc.txt all'interno della cartella test_data"
        m_search = re.search(
            r"^(?:cerca|trova|dove si trova)\s+(?:il\s+)?file\s+['\"]?([\w\.\-]+)['\"]?(?:\s+(?:all'interno|dentro|nella\s+cartella|in)\s+['\"]?([\w\.\-/]+)['\"]?)?$",
            t_norm
        )
        if m_search:
            q = m_search.group(1).strip()
            p = (m_search.group(2) or ".").strip()
            return ("search_files", {"query": q, "path": p})

        # Es: "cerca sample_doc.txt nella cartella test_data"
        m_search2 = re.search(r"^cerca\s+['\"]?([\w\.\-]+)['\"]?\s+(?:nella\s+cartella|in)\s+['\"]?([\w\.\-/]+)['\"]?$", t_norm)
        if m_search2:
            return ("search_files", {"query": m_search2.group(1).strip(), "path": m_search2.group(2).strip()})

        # 4. Lettura file con percorso esplicito
        # Es: "leggi il file test_data/sample_doc.txt" o "leggi test_data/sample_doc.txt"
        m_read = re.search(
            r"^(?:leggi|mostra\s+il\s+contenuto\s+di|apri\s+in\s+lettura|leggi\s+il\s+contenuto\s+di)\s+(?:il\s+)?(?:file\s+)?['\"]?([\w\.\-/\\]+\.\w+)['\"]?$",
            t_norm
        )
        if m_read:
            return ("read_document", {"path": m_read.group(1).strip()})

        # 5. Elenco cartella
        # Es: "elenca i file nella cartella test_data", "elenca la cartella backend"
        m_dir = re.search(
            r"^(?:elenca|mostra)\s+(?:il\s+contenuto\s+della|i\s+file\s+nella|la)?\s*cartella\s+['\"]?([\w\.\-/\\]+)['\"]?$",
            t_norm
        )
        if m_dir:
            return ("list_directory", {"path": m_dir.group(1).strip()})

        # 6. Ispezione archivio ZIP
        # Es: "ispeziona l'archivio test_data/sample_archive.zip"
        m_zip = re.search(
            r"^(?:elenca\s+i\s+file\s+nello\s+zip|ispeziona\s+l'archivio|mostra\s+i\s+file\s+nell'archivio|ispeziona\s+lo\s+zip)\s+['\"]?([\w\.\-/\\]+\.zip)['\"]?$",
            t_norm
        )
        if m_zip:
            return ("inspect_zip", {"zip_path": m_zip.group(1).strip(), "action": "list"})

        return None

    @classmethod
    async def execute_fast_path(
        cls,
        action: str,
        params: Dict[str, Any],
        bot_id: str = "chief"
    ) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """
        Esegue l'operazione in modalità Fast Path ultra-veloce senza passare per l'LLM.
        """
        t0 = time.time()

        if action == "list_windows":
            res = tools_os.list_windows()
            dur_ms = int((time.time() - t0) * 1000)
            wins = res.get("windows", [])
            w_preview = "\n".join([f"- `{w}`" for w in wins[:8]]) or "*Nessuna finestra rilevata.*"
            content = (
                f"⚡ **Fast Path (Esecuzione Istantanea — 0s LLM):**\n\n"
                f"🪟 **Finestre Windows Attive ({len(wins)}):**\n{w_preview}"
            )
            return {
                "handled": True,
                "action": action,
                "content": content,
                "tool_name": "list_windows",
                "tool_result": res,
                "duration_ms": dur_ms,
            }

        elif action == "system_status":
            ram = get_system_ram_info()
            power = get_system_power_info()
            m_status = local_model_mgr.get_status()
            dur_ms = int((time.time() - t0) * 1000)

            p_state = "In carica / Alimentazione AC 🔌" if power.get("ac_power") else f"Batteria ({power.get('battery_percent', 0)}%) 🔋"
            content = (
                f"⚡ **Fast Path — Stato del Sistema CoworkerOS (0s LLM):**\n\n"
                f"- **RAM Totale:** {ram.get('total_gb', 0)} GB\n"
                f"- **RAM Disponibile:** {ram.get('available_gb', 0)} GB ({ram.get('used_percent', 0)}% occupata)\n"
                f"- **Alimentazione:** {p_state}\n"
                f"- **Modello Locale:** Qwen3.5-4B Q4_K_M (`llama-server` PID: {m_status.get('server_pid') or 'Non attivo'})\n"
                f"- **Stato Server:** {'Attivo e pronto' if m_status.get('server_running') else 'Spento (avvio on-demand)'}\n"
                f"- **RSS Memoria Server:** {m_status.get('server_rss_mb', 0)} MB\n"
                f"- **Configurazione CPU:** 6 thread calcolo, 8 thread batch, priorità alta (--prio 2)"
            )
            return {
                "handled": True,
                "action": action,
                "content": content,
                "tool_name": "system_status",
                "tool_result": {"ram": ram, "power": power, "model": m_status},
                "duration_ms": dur_ms,
            }

        elif action == "search_files":
            q = params.get("query", "")
            p = params.get("path", ".")
            res = tools_os.search_files(q, p)
            dur_ms = int((time.time() - t0) * 1000)
            tot = res.get("total_matches", 0)
            matches = res.get("matches", [])
            if tot > 0:
                list_str = "\n".join([f"- `{m['relative_path']}` ({m['size_bytes']} bytes)" for m in matches[:6]])
                content = (
                    f"⚡ **Fast Path (Esecuzione Istantanea — 0s LLM):**\n\n"
                    f"🔎 **File trovato ('{q}'):**\n{list_str}"
                )
            else:
                content = (
                    f"⚡ **Fast Path (Esecuzione Istantanea — 0s LLM):**\n\n"
                    f"🔎 Nessun file corrispondente a '{q}' trovato nel percorso `{p}`."
                )
            return {
                "handled": True,
                "action": action,
                "content": content,
                "tool_name": "search_files",
                "tool_result": res,
                "duration_ms": dur_ms,
            }

        elif action == "read_document":
            p = params.get("path", "")
            res = tools_os.read_document(p, max_lines=200)
            dur_ms = int((time.time() - t0) * 1000)
            if res.get("status") == "ok":
                content_text = res.get("content", "").strip()
                if len(content_text) > 800:
                    content_text = content_text[:800] + "\n... [troncato per brevità]"
                content = (
                    f"⚡ **Fast Path (Esecuzione Istantanea — 0s LLM):**\n\n"
                    f"📄 **Lettura Documento (`{p}`, {res.get('line_count')} righe):**\n```text\n{content_text}\n```"
                )
            else:
                content = (
                    f"⚡ **Fast Path (Esecuzione Istantanea — 0s LLM):**\n\n"
                    f"⚠️ **Errore lettura documento:** {res.get('message')}"
                )
            return {
                "handled": True,
                "action": action,
                "content": content,
                "tool_name": "read_document",
                "tool_result": res,
                "duration_ms": dur_ms,
            }

        elif action == "list_directory":
            p = params.get("path", ".")
            res = tools_os.manage_files(action="list", path=p, approved=False)
            dur_ms = int((time.time() - t0) * 1000)
            if res.get("status") == "ok":
                entries = res.get("entries", [])
                e_str = "\n".join([f"- `{'[DIR]' if e.get('is_dir') else '[FILE]'} {e.get('name')}`" for e in entries[:10]])
                content = (
                    f"⚡ **Fast Path (Esecuzione Istantanea — 0s LLM):**\n\n"
                    f"📁 **Contenuto Cartella (`{p}`):**\n{e_str}"
                )
            else:
                content = f"⚡ **Fast Path:** ⚠️ {res.get('message')}"
            return {
                "handled": True,
                "action": action,
                "content": content,
                "tool_name": "manage_files",
                "tool_result": res,
                "duration_ms": dur_ms,
            }

        elif action == "inspect_zip":
            zp = params.get("zip_path", "")
            res = tools_os.inspect_zip(zp, action="list")
            dur_ms = int((time.time() - t0) * 1000)
            if res.get("status") == "ok":
                files = res.get("entries", [])
                f_str = "\n".join([f"- `{f['filename']}` ({f.get('file_size', f.get('size_bytes', 0))} bytes)" for f in files[:8]])
                content = (
                    f"⚡ **Fast Path (Esecuzione Istantanea — 0s LLM):**\n\n"
                    f"📦 **Archivio ZIP (`{zp}`, {res.get('total_entries')} elementi):**\n{f_str}"
                )
            else:
                content = f"⚡ **Fast Path:** ⚠️ {res.get('message')}"
            return {
                "handled": True,
                "action": action,
                "content": content,
                "tool_name": "inspect_zip",
                "tool_result": res,
                "duration_ms": dur_ms,
            }

        return {
            "handled": False,
            "error": "Azione fast path non supportata."
        }

// === FILE: backend\local_model_manager.py ===

import os
import sys
import time
import json
import atexit
import psutil
import asyncio
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Dict, Any, List, Optional, Tuple, Callable, Awaitable
import httpx

LLAMA_SERVER_BIN = Path(r"C:\Users\costa\ai_local\bin\llama-server.exe")
MODEL_PATH = Path(r"C:\Users\costa\ai_local\models\Qwen_Qwen3.5-4B-Q4_K_M.gguf")
MMPROJ_PATH = Path(r"C:\Users\costa\ai_local\models\mmproj-Qwen_Qwen3.5-4B-f16.gguf")
SERVER_HOST = "127.0.0.1"
SERVER_PORT = 8080
BASE_URL = f"http://{SERVER_HOST}:{SERVER_PORT}"

# Soglia minima di sicurezza RAM libera per avvio a freddo (GB)
MIN_RAM_FREE_GB = 3.2


def get_system_power_info() -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """Rileva lo stato di alimentazione (AC collegato vs Batteria) e percentuale residua."""
    try:
        b = psutil.sensors_battery()
        return {
            "power_source": "AC" if (b is None or b.power_plugged) else "BATTERY",
            "battery_pct": b.percent if b else None,
            "is_plugged": b.power_plugged if b else True,
        }
    except Exception:
        return {"power_source": "UNKNOWN", "battery_pct": None, "is_plugged": True}


def get_system_ram_info() -> Dict[str, float]:
    """Rileva la memoria RAM totale, disponibile e usata in GB."""
    v = psutil.virtual_memory()
    return {
        "total_gb": round(v.total / (1024**3), 2),
        "available_gb": round(v.available / (1024**3), 2),
        "used_gb": round(v.used / (1024**3), 2),
        "percent": round(v.percent, 1),
    }


class LocalModelManager:
    """
    Gestore del ciclo di vita e dell'inferenza di llama-server per Qwen3.5-4B.
    Garantisce:
    - Controllo RAM prima del caricamento (prevenzione thrashing)
    - Prevenzione istanze duplicate
    - Avvio controllato (background senza finestre CMD)
    - Arresto pulito alla chiusura dell'app (atexit e shutdown)
    - Inferenza sequenziale con mutex (una richiesta alla volta)
    - Supporto visione su richiesta (--mmproj)
    """

    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self.process: Optional[subprocess.Popen] = None
        self.is_vision_enabled: bool = False
        self._lock = asyncio.Lock()
        self._status: str = "stopped"  # stopped, starting, running, error, low_ram
        self._last_error: str = ""
        self._pid: Optional[int] = None
        atexit.register(self.stop_server_sync)

    def is_server_healthy(self, timeout: float = 0.5) -> bool:
        """Verifica se l'endpoint /health di llama-server risponde 200 OK."""
        if self.process is None or self.process.poll() is not None:
            return False
        try:
            with httpx.Client(timeout=timeout) as client:
                r = client.get(f"{BASE_URL}/health")
                return r.status_code == 200
        except Exception:
            return False

    async def is_server_healthy_async(self, timeout: float = 0.5) -> bool:
        """Verifica asincrona se l'endpoint /health risponde 200 OK."""
        if self.process is None or self.process.poll() is not None:
            return False
        try:
            async with httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=timeout) as client:
                r = await client.get(f"{BASE_URL}/health")
                return r.status_code == 200
        except Exception:
            return False

    def start_server_sync(self, enable_vision: bool = False) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """Avvio sincrono di llama-server con controlli preventivi di sicurezza."""
        if self.is_server_healthy():
            self._status = "running"
            return {
                "success": True,
                "message": "llama-server è già attivo e pronto.",
                "status": "running",
                "vision": self.is_vision_enabled,
            }

        # 1. Verifica esistenza binario ed eseguibile
        if not LLAMA_SERVER_BIN.exists():
            err = f"Eseguibile llama-server non trovato in: {LLAMA_SERVER_BIN}"
            self._status = "error"
            self._last_error = err
            return {"success": False, "error": err, "status": "error"}

        if not MODEL_PATH.exists():
            err = f"File modello Qwen3.5-4B non trovato in: {MODEL_PATH}"
            self._status = "error"
            self._last_error = err
            return {"success": False, "error": err, "status": "error"}

        # 2. Controllo RAM disponibile prima dell'avvio
        ram_info = get_system_ram_info()
        if ram_info["available_gb"] < MIN_RAM_FREE_GB:
            err = (
                f"RAM disponibile insufficiente ({ram_info['available_gb']} GB liberi). "
                f"Per caricare Qwen3.5-4B in sicurezza sono necessari almeno {MIN_RAM_FREE_GB} GB di RAM libera. "
                "Chiudi Google Chrome o altre applicazioni superflue per liberare memoria prima di avviare il modello."
            )
            self._status = "low_ram"
            self._last_error = err
            return {
                "success": False,
                "error": err,
                "status": "low_ram",
                "ram_info": ram_info,
            }

        # 3. Costruzione comando per llama-server
        cmd = [
            str(LLAMA_SERVER_BIN),
            "-m", str(MODEL_PATH),
            "-c", "4096",
            "-t", "6",
            "-tb", "8",
            "-np", "1",
            "--prio", "2",
            "--reasoning", "off",
            "--reasoning-budget", "0",
            "--slot-prompt-similarity", "0.10",
            "--host", SERVER_HOST,
            "--port", str(SERVER_PORT),
        ]

        if enable_vision and MMPROJ_PATH.exists():
            cmd.extend(["--mmproj", str(MMPROJ_PATH)])
            self.is_vision_enabled = True
        else:
            self.is_vision_enabled = False

        self._status = "starting"
        creationflags = getattr(subprocess, "CREATE_NO_WINDOW", 0x08000000)

        try:
            self.process = subprocess.Popen(
                cmd,
                stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL,
                stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL,
                creationflags=creationflags,
            )
            self._pid = self.process.pid

            # Attesa attiva fino a 35 secondi che il server risponda su /health
            t0 = time.time()
            while time.time() - t0 < 35.0:
                if self.process.poll() is not None:
                    # Il processo è uscito prematuramente
                    self._status = "error"
                    self._last_error = f"llama-server è terminato con codice di uscita {self.process.returncode}."
                    return {"success": False, "error": self._last_error, "status": "error"}

                if self.is_server_healthy(timeout=0.6):
                    self._status = "running"
                    self._last_error = ""
                    return {
                        "success": True,
                        "message": f"Qwen3.5-4B avviato con successo in {round(time.time() - t0, 1)}s.",
                        "status": "running",
                        "vision": self.is_vision_enabled,
                        "pid": self._pid,
                    }
                time.sleep(0.5)

            # Timeout
            self._status = "error"
            self._last_error = "Timeout durante l'avvio di llama-server (35 secondi superati)."
            self.stop_server_sync()
            return {"success": False, "error": self._last_error, "status": "error"}

        except Exception as e:
            self._status = "error"
            self._last_error = f"Errore durante l'avvio del processo: {e}"
            return {"success": False, "error": self._last_error, "status": "error"}

    async def start_server_async(self, enable_vision: bool = False) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """Avvio asincrono non bloccante di llama-server."""
        return await asyncio.to_thread(self.start_server_sync, enable_vision)

    def stop_server_sync(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """Arresto controllato di llama-server."""
        stopped_pid = None
        try:
            if self.process and self.process.poll() is None:
                stopped_pid = self.process.pid
                self.process.terminate()
                try:
                    self.process.wait(timeout=5.0)
                except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
                    self.process.kill()
            self.process = None
            self._pid = None

            # Pulizia preventiva di eventuali processi residui di llama-server
            for p in psutil.process_iter(["name", "pid"]):
                try:
                    if "llama-server" in (p.info["name"] or "").lower():
                        p.terminate()
                        p.wait(timeout=3.0)
                except Exception:
                    pass

            self._status = "stopped"
            self.is_vision_enabled = False
            return {
                "success": True,
                "message": "llama-server arrestato correttamente.",
                "status": "stopped",
                "stopped_pid": stopped_pid,
            }
        except Exception as e:
            self._status = "error"
            self._last_error = f"Errore durante l'arresto: {e}"
            return {"success": False, "error": self._last_error, "status": "error"}

    async def stop_server_async(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """Arresto asincrono di llama-server."""
        return await asyncio.to_thread(self.stop_server_sync)

    def get_status(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """Restituisce lo stato dettagliato del runtime locale, RAM e modello."""
        alive = self.is_server_healthy()
        if alive:
            self._status = "running"
        elif self._status == "running":
            self._status = "stopped"

        ram_info = get_system_ram_info()
        server_rss_mb = 0.0

        if self._pid and alive:
            try:
                proc = psutil.Process(self._pid)
                server_rss_mb = round(proc.memory_info().rss / (1024**2), 1)
            except Exception:
                pass

        return {
            "status": self._status,
            "is_alive": alive,
            "pid": self._pid,
            "server_rss_mb": server_rss_mb,
            "vision_enabled": self.is_vision_enabled,
            "ram_info": ram_info,
            "power_info": get_system_power_info(),
            "min_ram_required_gb": MIN_RAM_FREE_GB,
            "endpoint": BASE_URL,
            "last_error": self._last_error,
        }

    async def chat_completion(
        self,
        messages: List[Dict[str, Any]],
        tools: Optional[List[Dict[str, Any]]] = None,
        temperature: float = 0.2,
        max_tokens: int = 256,
        timeout: float = 180.0,
        on_chunk: Optional[Callable[[str], Awaitable[None]]] = None,
    ) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """
        Esegue una richiesta di completamento chat verso llama-server.
        Supporta sia output completo che streaming progressivo dei token (on_chunk).
        Usa un asyncio.Lock per garantire che venga eseguita UNA sola inferenza alla volta.
        """
        async with self._lock:
            # 1. Verifica che il server sia attivo, altrimenti tenta l'avvio controllato
            if not await self.is_server_healthy_async():
                start_res = await self.start_server_async()
                if not start_res["success"]:
                    return {
                        "success": False,
                        "error": start_res.get("error", "Impossibile avviare llama-server locale."),
                        "status": start_res.get("status", "error"),
                    }

            is_stream = on_chunk is not None
            payload: Dict[str, Any] = {
                "messages": messages,
                "temperature": temperature,
                "max_tokens": max_tokens,
                "stream": is_stream,
            }
            if is_stream:
                payload["stream_options"] = {"include_usage": True}
            if tools:
                payload["tools"] = tools

            url = f"{BASE_URL}/v1/chat/completions"
            t_start = time.time()

            try:
                if is_stream:
                    async with httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=timeout) as client:
                        async with client.stream("POST", url, json=payload) as resp:
                            duration_s = round(time.time() - t_start, 2)
                            if resp.status_code != 200:
                                body = await resp.aread()
                                return {
                                    "success": False,
                                    "error": f"llama-server ha risposto con codice HTTP {resp.status_code}: {body.decode(errors='replace')}",
                                    "status": "error",
                                    "duration_s": duration_s,
                                }

                            accumulated_content = []
                            tool_calls_dict: Dict[int, Dict[str, Any]] = {}
                            usage = {}
                            timings = {}

                            async for line in resp.aiter_lines():
                                line = line.strip()
                                if not line or not line.startswith("data: "):
                                    continue
                                if line == "data: [DONE]":
                                    break
                                try:
                                    item = json.loads(line[6:])
                                    if "usage" in item and item["usage"]:
                                        usage = item["usage"]
                                    if "timings" in item and item["timings"]:
                                        timings = item["timings"]
                                    choices = item.get("choices", [])
                                    if choices:
                                        delta = choices[0].get("delta", {})
                                        chunk_text = delta.get("content", "")
                                        if chunk_text:
                                            accumulated_content.append(chunk_text)
                                            if on_chunk:
                                                await on_chunk(chunk_text)
                                        # Tool calls delta
                                        tcs = delta.get("tool_calls", [])
                                        for tc in tcs:
                                            idx = tc.get("index", 0)
                                            if idx not in tool_calls_dict:
                                                tool_calls_dict[idx] = {
                                                    "id": tc.get("id", ""),
                                                    "type": tc.get("type", "function"),
                                                    "function": {"name": "", "arguments": ""}
                                                }
                                            fn = tc.get("function", {})
                                            if fn.get("name"):
                                                tool_calls_dict[idx]["function"]["name"] += fn["name"]
                                            if fn.get("arguments"):
                                                tool_calls_dict[idx]["function"]["arguments"] += fn["arguments"]
                                            if tc.get("id"):
                                                tool_calls_dict[idx]["id"] = tc["id"]
                                except Exception:
                                    pass

                            total_tool_calls = [tool_calls_dict[i] for i in sorted(tool_calls_dict.keys())]
                            final_content = "".join(accumulated_content)
                            duration_s = round(time.time() - t_start, 2)

                            return {
                                "success": True,
                                "content": final_content,
                                "tool_calls": total_tool_calls,
                                "usage": usage,
                                "timings": timings,
                                "duration_s": duration_s,
                            }
                else:
                    async with httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=timeout) as client:
                        resp = await client.post(url, json=payload)
                        duration_s = round(time.time() - t_start, 2)

                        if resp.status_code != 200:
                            return {
                                "success": False,
                                "error": f"llama-server ha risposto con codice HTTP {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}",
                                "status": "error",
                                "duration_s": duration_s,
                            }

                        data = resp.json()
                        choices = data.get("choices", [])
                        if not choices:
                            return {
                                "success": False,
                                "error": "Risposta vuota ricevuta da llama-server.",
                                "status": "error",
                                "duration_s": duration_s,
                            }

                        message = choices[0].get("message", {})
                        content = message.get("content", "") or ""
                        tool_calls = message.get("tool_calls", [])
                        usage = data.get("usage", {})
                        timings = data.get("timings", {})

                        return {
                            "success": True,
                            "content": content,
                            "tool_calls": tool_calls,
                            "usage": usage,
                            "timings": timings,
                            "duration_s": duration_s,
                        }

            except httpx.TimeoutException:
                return {
                    "success": False,
                    "error": f"Timeout dell'inferenza locale ({timeout}s superati).",
                    "status": "timeout",
                }
            except Exception as e:
                return {
                    "success": False,
                    "error": f"Errore di comunicazione con llama-server: {e}",
                    "status": "error",
                }


local_model_mgr = LocalModelManager()

AUTH_TOKEN = os.getenv("COWORKEROS_AUTH_TOKEN", "").strip()
if not AUTH_TOKEN or AUTH_TOKEN in ("your_token_here", "null"):
    AUTH_TOKEN = secrets.token_hex(32)
    os.environ["COWORKEROS_AUTH_TOKEN"] = AUTH_TOKEN
    set_key(str(ENV_PATH), "COWORKEROS_AUTH_TOKEN", AUTH_TOKEN)

# Store in-memory dei ticket effimeri monouso per WebSocket (validità 15 secondi)
_WS_TICKETS: Dict[str, float] = {}


def create_ws_ticket() -> str:
    """Genera un ticket monouso con validità di 15 secondi."""
    now = time.time()
    for t, exp in list(_WS_TICKETS.items()):
        if exp < now:
            _WS_TICKETS.pop(t, None)
    ticket = secrets.token_urlsafe(32)
    _WS_TICKETS[ticket] = now + 15.0
    return ticket


def consume_ws_ticket(ticket_candidate: Optional[str]) -> bool:
    """Verifica e consuma immediatamente un ticket monouso."""
    if not ticket_candidate:
        return False
    now = time.time()
    expiry = _WS_TICKETS.pop(ticket_candidate.strip(), None)
    if expiry and expiry >= now:
        return True
    return False

# 2. CORS ristretto esclusivamente a loopback (nessun wildcard)
app.add_middleware(
    CORSMiddleware,
    allow_origins=[
        "http://127.0.0.1:8000",
        "http://localhost:8000",
        "http://127.0.0.1:5173",
        "http://localhost:5173",
        "null",
        "file://",
    ],
    allow_origin_regex=r"^https?://(127\.0\.0\.1|localhost)(:\d+)?$",
    allow_credentials=True,
    allow_methods=["GET", "POST", "PUT", "DELETE", "OPTIONS"],
    allow_headers=["*"],
)


def verify_auth_token_value(token_candidate: Optional[str]) -> bool:
    """Verifica il token di autenticazione locale in tempo costante."""
    if not token_candidate:
        return False
    candidate_clean = token_candidate.strip()
    return hmac.compare_digest(candidate_clean, AUTH_TOKEN)


def verify_auth(
    authorization: Optional[str] = Header(None),
    x_coworkeros_token: Optional[str] = Header(None),
) -> str:
    """
    Dependency FastAPI per proteggere gli endpoint sensibili.
    Accetta credenziali ESCLUSIVAMENTE tramite header autorizzati (Authorization: Bearer o X-CoworkerOS-Token).
    Il passaggio di token via query parameter (?token=) è rigorosamente disabilitato.
    """
    extracted = None
    if authorization:
        parts = authorization.split()
        if len(parts) == 2 and parts[0].lower() == "bearer":
            extracted = parts[1]
        else:
            extracted = authorization
    elif x_coworkeros_token:
        extracted = x_coworkeros_token

    if not verify_auth_token_value(extracted):
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_401_UNAUTHORIZED,
            detail="Non autorizzato: credenziali locali non valide o mancanti negli header.",
            headers={"WWW-Authenticate": "Bearer"},
        )
    return str(extracted)


class ConnectionManager:
    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self.active_connections: Dict[str, List[WebSocket]] = {}

    async def connect(self, chat_id: str, websocket: WebSocket) -> None:
        await websocket.accept()
        self.active_connections.setdefault(chat_id, []).append(websocket)

    def disconnect(self, chat_id: str, websocket: WebSocket) -> None:
        if chat_id in self.active_connections:
            self.active_connections[chat_id] = [
                ws for ws in self.active_connections[chat_id] if ws != websocket
            ]

    async def broadcast(self, chat_id: str, payload: Dict[str, Any]) -> None:
        conns = list(self.active_connections.get(chat_id, []))
        for ws in conns:
            try:
                await ws.send_json(payload)
            except Exception:
                self.disconnect(chat_id, ws)


manager = ConnectionManager()

@app.on_event("startup")
async def on_startup() -> None:
    db.init_db()
    db.seed_db()
    recovered = db.recover_interrupted_tasks()
    if recovered:
        print(f"[CoworkerOS] Recuperati {len(recovered)} task interrotti al riavvio.")
    orchestrator.reload_client()

    async def broadcast_notification_event(payload: Dict[str, Any]) -> None:
        for cid in list(manager.active_connections.keys()):
            await manager.broadcast(cid, payload)

    notification_manager.register_broadcast_callback(broadcast_notification_event)
    await scheduler_service.start_background_loop()


@app.on_event("shutdown")
async def on_shutdown() -> None:
    await scheduler_service.stop_background_loop()
    await local_model_mgr.stop_server_async()

@app.post("/api/chats/{chat_id}/messages")
async def api_send_message(
    chat_id: str,
    req: SendMessageRequest,
    _auth: str = Depends(verify_auth)
) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    content = req.content.strip()
    if not content:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Messaggio vuoto non valido")

    user_msg = db.save_message(
        chat_id=chat_id,
        sender_id="user",
        sender_name=req.sender_name or "You",
        content=content,
        action_card_json=json.dumps(req.action_card) if isinstance(req.action_card, dict) else req.action_card,
    )
    await manager.broadcast(chat_id, {"type": "new_message", "message": user_msg})

    bot_replies = await orchestrator.handle_conversation_turn(
        chat_id=chat_id,
        user_content=content,
        broadcast_fn=manager.broadcast,
        target_bot_id=req.target_bot_id,
    )
    current_chat = db.get_chat(chat_id)
    return {
        "status": "ok",
        "user_message": user_msg,
        "bot_replies": bot_replies,
        "chat": current_chat,
        "updated_chat": current_chat,
    }


@app.post("/api/bots")
def api_create_bot(req: CreateBotRequest, _auth: str = Depends(verify_auth)) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    bot_id = req.name.lower().strip().replace(" ", "_")
    bot_data = {
        "id": bot_id,
        "name": req.name.strip(),
        "role": req.role.strip(),
        "system_prompt": req.system_prompt or f"Sei {req.name}, {req.role}.",
        "shape": req.shape,
        "color": req.color,
        "effort": req.effort,
    }
    created_bot = db.create_bot(bot_data)
    created_chat = db.create_chat(req.name.strip(), [bot_id], chat_id=f"chat_{bot_id}")
    return {"bot": created_bot, "chat": created_chat}

    if not job:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Attività programmata non trovata")

@app.put("/api/scheduler/jobs/{job_id}")
def api_update_scheduled_job(
    job_id: str,
    req: UpdateScheduledJobRequest,
    _auth: str = Depends(verify_auth),
) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    job = db.get_scheduled_job(job_id)
    if not job:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Attività programmata non trovata")

    if req.status == "active" and job.get("status") == "paused":
        updated = scheduler_service.resume_job(job_id)
    elif req.status == "paused":
        updated = scheduler_service.pause_job(job_id)
    else:
        updated = db.update_scheduled_job(
            job_id=job_id,
            name=req.name,
            prompt=req.prompt,
            schedule_type=req.schedule_type,
            schedule_config=req.schedule_config,
            timezone=req.timezone,
            status=req.status,
            missed_job_policy=req.missed_job_policy,
            description=req.description,
        )
    return {"status": "ok", "job": updated}

    job_id: str,
    _auth: str = Depends(verify_auth),
) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    job = db.get_scheduled_job(job_id)
    if not job:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Attività programmata non trovata")
    now_iso = datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()
    exec_rec = db.create_job_execution(job_id=job_id, scheduled_for=now_iso, status="running")
    asyncio.create_task(scheduler_service._execute_job_instance(job, exec_rec["id"], now_iso))
    return {"status": "ok", "message": "Esecuzione avviata", "execution_id": exec_rec["id"]}
