pyautogui.FAILSAFE = False
pyautogui.PAUSE = 0.08

SRCCOPY = 0x00CC0020
CAPTUREBLT = 0x40000000
DIB_RGB_COLORS = 0
BI_RGB = 0
SW_RESTORE = 9
SW_SHOW = 5
VK_MENU = 0x12
KEYEVENTF_EXTENDEDKEY = 0x0001
KEYEVENTF_KEYUP = 0x0002
HWND_TOPMOST = -1
HWND_NOTOPMOST = -2
SWP_NOMOVE = 0x0002
SWP_NOSIZE = 0x0001
SWP_SHOWWINDOW = 0x0040


class BITMAPINFOHEADER(ctypes.Structure):
    _fields_ = [
        ("biSize", ctypes.c_uint32),
        ("biWidth", ctypes.c_int32),
        ("biHeight", ctypes.c_int32),
        ("biPlanes", ctypes.c_uint16),
        ("biBitCount", ctypes.c_uint16),
        ("biCompression", ctypes.c_uint32),
        ("biSizeImage", ctypes.c_uint32),
        ("biXPelsPerMeter", ctypes.c_int32),
        ("biYPelsPerMeter", ctypes.c_int32),
        ("biClrUsed", ctypes.c_uint32),
        ("biClrImportant", ctypes.c_uint32),
    ]


class BITMAPINFO(ctypes.Structure):
    _fields_ = [
        ("bmiHeader", BITMAPINFOHEADER),
        ("bmiColors", ctypes.c_uint32 * 3),
    ]


class RECT(ctypes.Structure):
    _fields_ = [
        ("left", ctypes.c_long),
        ("top", ctypes.c_long),
        ("right", ctypes.c_long),
        ("bottom", ctypes.c_long),
    ]


def get_physical_screen_size() -> Tuple[int, int]:
    if sys.platform == "win32":
        try:
            user32 = ctypes.windll.user32
            w = user32.GetSystemMetrics(0)
            h = user32.GetSystemMetrics(1)
            if w > 0 and h > 0:
                return int(w), int(h)
        except Exception:
            pass
    size = pyautogui.size()
    return int(size.width), int(size.height)


def _is_image_black(img: Optional[Image.Image]) -> bool:
    if img is None:
        return True
    try:
        gray = img.convert("L")
        stat = ImageStat.Stat(gray)
        min_val, max_val = stat.extrema[0]
        mean_val = stat.mean[0]
        std_val = stat.stddev[0]
        if max_val < 10 or (mean_val < 1.8 and std_val < 1.2):
            return True
        return False
    except Exception:
        return True


def _capture_via_win32_bitblt_captureblt(width: int, height: int) -> Optional[Image.Image]:
    if sys.platform != "win32":
        return None
    user32 = ctypes.windll.user32
    gdi32 = ctypes.windll.gdi32
    hdesktop = user32.GetDesktopWindow()
    hdc_screen = user32.GetWindowDC(hdesktop)
    if not hdc_screen:
        return None
    hdc_mem = gdi32.CreateCompatibleDC(hdc_screen)
    hbmp = gdi32.CreateCompatibleBitmap(hdc_screen, width, height)
    if not hbmp:
        gdi32.DeleteDC(hdc_mem)
        user32.ReleaseDC(hdesktop, hdc_screen)
        return None

    old_obj = gdi32.SelectObject(hdc_mem, hbmp)
    try:
        ok = gdi32.BitBlt(
            hdc_mem, 0, 0, width, height,
            hdc_screen, 0, 0, SRCCOPY | CAPTUREBLT
        )
        if not ok:
            return None

        bmi = BITMAPINFO()
        bmi.bmiHeader.biSize = ctypes.sizeof(BITMAPINFOHEADER)
        bmi.bmiHeader.biWidth = width
        bmi.bmiHeader.biHeight = -height
        bmi.bmiHeader.biPlanes = 1
        bmi.bmiHeader.biBitCount = 32
        bmi.bmiHeader.biCompression = BI_RGB

        buf_len = width * height * 4
        buffer = ctypes.create_string_buffer(buf_len)
        lines = gdi32.GetDIBits(
            hdc_mem, hbmp, 0, height, buffer, ctypes.byref(bmi), DIB_RGB_COLORS
        )
        if lines != height:
            return None

        img = Image.frombuffer("RGB", (width, height), buffer, "raw", "BGRX", 0, 1)
        return img.copy()
    except Exception:
        return None
    finally:
        gdi32.SelectObject(hdc_mem, old_obj)
        gdi32.DeleteObject(hbmp)
        gdi32.DeleteDC(hdc_mem)
        user32.ReleaseDC(hdesktop, hdc_screen)


def _capture_via_powershell_dotnet() -> Optional[Image.Image]:
    if sys.platform != "win32":
        return None
    try:
        tmp_path = Path(os.environ.get("TEMP", ".")) / "coworkeros_cap.png"
        ps_script = (
            "Add-Type -AssemblyName System.Windows.Forms,System.Drawing; "
            "$b = [System.Windows.Forms.Screen]::PrimaryScreen.Bounds; "
            "$bmp = New-Object System.Drawing.Bitmap($b.Width, $b.Height); "
            "$g = [System.Drawing.Graphics]::FromImage($bmp); "
            "$g.CopyFromScreen($b.Location, [System.Drawing.Point]::Empty, $b.Size); "
            f"$bmp.Save('{str(tmp_path)}', [System.Drawing.Imaging.ImageFormat]::Png); "
            "$g.Dispose(); $bmp.Dispose();"
        )
        creationflags = getattr(subprocess, "CREATE_NO_WINDOW", 0x08000000)
        subprocess.run(
            ["powershell", "-NoProfile", "-NonInteractive", "-Command", ps_script],
            timeout=3.5,
            check=False,
            creationflags=creationflags
        )
        if tmp_path.exists():
            img = Image.open(tmp_path).convert("RGB")
            return img.copy()
    except Exception:
        pass
    return None


def _draw_som_grid_and_crosshair(
    img: Image.Image,
    real_w: int,
    real_h: int,
    highlight_x: Optional[int] = None,
    highlight_y: Optional[int] = None,
    draw_grid: bool = False
) -> Image.Image:
    annotated = img.copy().convert("RGBA")
    overlay = Image.new("RGBA", annotated.size, (0, 0, 0, 0))
    draw = ImageDraw.Draw(overlay)
    out_w, out_h = annotated.size

    if draw_grid:
        for step in range(100, 1000, 100):
            gx = int((step / 1000.0) * out_w)
            gy = int((step / 1000.0) * out_h)
            draw.line([(gx, 0), (gx, out_h)], fill=(255, 255, 255, 45), width=1)
            draw.line([(0, gy), (out_w, gy)], fill=(255, 255, 255, 45), width=1)
        for nx in range(200, 1000, 200):
            for ny in range(200, 1000, 200):
                px = int((nx / 1000.0) * out_w)
                py = int((ny / 1000.0) * out_h)
                label = f"{nx},{ny}"
                draw.rectangle([px - 22, py - 8, px + 22, py + 8], fill=(17, 24, 39, 155))
                draw.text((px - 19, py - 6), label, fill=(255, 255, 255, 230))

    if highlight_x is not None and highlight_y is not None and real_w > 0 and real_h > 0:
        cx = int((highlight_x / float(real_w)) * out_w)
        cy = int((highlight_y / float(real_h)) * out_h)
        r_outer = 22
        r_inner = 7
        draw.ellipse(
            [cx - r_outer, cy - r_outer, cx + r_outer, cy + r_outer],
            fill=(249, 115, 22, 75),
            outline=(249, 115, 22, 245),
            width=3
        )
        draw.ellipse(
            [cx - r_inner - 2, cy - r_inner - 2, cx + r_inner + 2, cy + r_inner + 2],
            fill=(255, 255, 255, 255)
        )
        draw.ellipse(
            [cx - r_inner, cy - r_inner, cx + r_inner, cy + r_inner],
            fill=(249, 115, 22, 255)
        )
        draw.line([(cx - 30, cy), (cx + 30, cy)], fill=(249, 115, 22, 230), width=2)
        draw.line([(cx, cy - 30), (cx, cy + 30)], fill=(249, 115, 22, 230), width=2)

    return Image.alpha_composite(annotated, overlay).convert("RGB")


def capture_screen_b64(
    highlight_x: Optional[int] = None,
    highlight_y: Optional[int] = None,
    draw_som_grid: bool = False
) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    real_w, real_h = get_physical_screen_size()
    captured_img: Optional[Image.Image] = None
    capture_method = "none"

    try:
        img1 = ImageGrab.grab(all_screens=False, include_layered_windows=True)
        if not _is_image_black(img1):
            captured_img = img1.convert("RGB")
            capture_method = "PIL.ImageGrab(layered)"
    except Exception:
        pass

    if captured_img is None:
        try:
            img2 = _capture_via_win32_bitblt_captureblt(real_w, real_h)
            if not _is_image_black(img2):
                captured_img = img2
                capture_method = "Win32.BitBlt(CAPTUREBLT)"
        except Exception:
            pass

    if captured_img is None:
        try:
            import dxcam  # type: ignore
            camera = dxcam.create(output_color="RGB")
            frame = camera.grab(new_frame_only=False)
            if frame is not None:
                img3 = Image.fromarray(frame)
                if not _is_image_black(img3):
                    captured_img = img3
                    capture_method = "DXcam.DXGI"
        except Exception:
            pass

    if captured_img is None:
        try:
            with mss.mss() as sct:
                monitor = sct.monitors[1] if len(sct.monitors) > 1 else sct.monitors[0]
                raw = sct.grab(monitor)
                img_mss = Image.frombytes("RGB", raw.size, raw.bgra, "raw", "BGRX")
                if not _is_image_black(img_mss):
                    captured_img = img_mss
                    capture_method = "mss"
        except Exception:
            pass

    if captured_img is None:
        img4 = _capture_via_powershell_dotnet()
        if not _is_image_black(img4):
            captured_img = img4
            capture_method = "PowerShell.CopyFromScreen"

    if captured_img is None:
        captured_img = Image.new("RGB", (real_w, real_h), (28, 32, 42))
        d = ImageDraw.Draw(captured_img)
        d.text((60, 50), f"Desktop Map ({real_w}x{real_h})", fill=(255, 255, 255))
        for w_info in list_open_windows().get("windows_detailed", [])[:8]:
            b = w_info.get("bounds", {})
            l, t, r, btm = b.get("left", 100), b.get("top", 100), b.get("right", 800), b.get("bottom", 600)
            d.rectangle([l, t, r, btm], outline=(96, 165, 250), fill=(38, 45, 64), width=3)
            d.text((l + 20, t + 20), w_info.get("title", "Window"), fill=(255, 255, 255))
        capture_method = "Win32.WindowMapFallback"

    real_w, real_h = captured_img.size
    preview_img = captured_img.copy()
    preview_img.thumbnail((1440, 960), Image.Resampling.LANCZOS)

    annotated_img = _draw_som_grid_and_crosshair(
        preview_img,
        real_w=real_w,
        real_h=real_h,
        highlight_x=highlight_x,
        highlight_y=highlight_y,
        draw_grid=draw_som_grid
    )

    buf = BytesIO()
    annotated_img.save(buf, format="JPEG", quality=84)
    b64_str = base64.b64encode(buf.getvalue()).decode("utf-8")

    norm_pct_x = round((highlight_x / float(real_w)) * 100.0, 1) if highlight_x is not None else 50.0
    norm_pct_y = round((highlight_y / float(real_h)) * 100.0, 1) if highlight_y is not None else 50.0

    return {
        "status": "ok",
        "capture_method": capture_method,
        "screenshot_b64": b64_str,
        "screen_width": real_w,
        "screen_height": real_h,
        "x": highlight_x,
        "y": highlight_y,
        "norm_pct_x": norm_pct_x,
        "norm_pct_y": norm_pct_y,
    }


def list_open_windows() -> Dict[str, Any]:
    windows_detailed: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []
    titles: List[str] = []

    if sys.platform == "win32":
        user32 = ctypes.windll.user32
        WNDENUMPROC = ctypes.WINFUNCTYPE(ctypes.c_bool, ctypes.c_void_p, ctypes.c_void_p)

        def _enum_cb(hwnd, lparam):
            if user32.IsWindowVisible(hwnd):
                length = user32.GetWindowTextLengthW(hwnd)
                if length > 0:
                    buff = ctypes.create_unicode_buffer(length + 1)
                    user32.GetWindowTextW(hwnd, buff, length + 1)
                    title = buff.value.strip()
                    if title and title not in ("Program Manager", "Settings", "Windows Input Experience"):
                        rect = RECT()
                        user32.GetWindowRect(hwnd, ctypes.byref(rect))
                        w = rect.right - rect.left
                        h = rect.bottom - rect.top
                        if w > 80 and h > 80:
                            titles.append(title)
                            windows_detailed.append({
                                "hwnd": int(hwnd),
                                "title": title,
                                "bounds": {
                                    "left": int(rect.left),
                                    "top": int(rect.top),
                                    "right": int(rect.right),
                                    "bottom": int(rect.bottom),
                                    "width": int(w),
                                    "height": int(h),
                                }
                            })
            return True

        user32.EnumWindows(WNDENUMPROC(_enum_cb), 0)
    else:
        try:
            for w in gw.getAllWindows():
                if w.title and w.visible:
                    titles.append(w.title)
        except Exception:
            pass

    return {
        "status": "ok",
        "count": len(titles),
        "windows": titles,
        "windows_detailed": windows_detailed,
    }


def force_activate_window(window_title_substring: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    target_sub = window_title_substring.strip().lower()
    win_data = list_open_windows().get("windows_detailed", [])

    candidates = [
        w for w in win_data
        if target_sub in w["title"].lower() and "coworkeros" not in w["title"].lower()
    ]
    if not candidates:
        candidates = [w for w in win_data if target_sub in w["title"].lower()]

    if not candidates:
        return {
            "status": "error",
            "message": f"Finestra '{window_title_substring}' non trovata.",
            "available_windows": [w["title"] for w in win_data[:12]],
        }

    chosen = candidates[0]
    hwnd = chosen["hwnd"]

    if sys.platform == "win32":
        user32 = ctypes.windll.user32
        kernel32 = ctypes.windll.kernel32
        try:
            if user32.IsIconic(hwnd):
                user32.ShowWindow(hwnd, SW_RESTORE)
                time.sleep(0.25)
            else:
                user32.ShowWindow(hwnd, SW_SHOW)

            user32.keybd_event(VK_MENU, 0, KEYEVENTF_EXTENDEDKEY, 0)
            user32.keybd_event(VK_MENU, 0, KEYEVENTF_EXTENDEDKEY | KEYEVENTF_KEYUP, 0)

            fg_hwnd = user32.GetForegroundWindow()
            fg_tid = user32.GetWindowThreadProcessId(fg_hwnd, None) if fg_hwnd else 0
            target_tid = user32.GetWindowThreadProcessId(hwnd, None)
            cur_tid = kernel32.GetCurrentThreadId()

            if fg_tid and fg_tid != cur_tid:
                user32.AttachThreadInput(fg_tid, cur_tid, True)
            if target_tid and target_tid != cur_tid:
                user32.AttachThreadInput(target_tid, cur_tid, True)

            try:
                user32.SetWindowPos(hwnd, HWND_TOPMOST, 0, 0, 0, 0, SWP_NOMOVE | SWP_NOSIZE | SWP_SHOWWINDOW)
                user32.SetWindowPos(hwnd, HWND_NOTOPMOST, 0, 0, 0, 0, SWP_NOMOVE | SWP_NOSIZE | SWP_SHOWWINDOW)
                user32.BringWindowToTop(hwnd)
                user32.SetForegroundWindow(hwnd)
                user32.SetFocus(hwnd)
            finally:
                if fg_tid and fg_tid != cur_tid:
                    user32.AttachThreadInput(fg_tid, cur_tid, False)
                if target_tid and target_tid != cur_tid:
                    user32.AttachThreadInput(target_tid, cur_tid, False)

            time.sleep(0.55)
            rect = RECT()
            user32.GetWindowRect(hwnd, ctypes.byref(rect))
            chosen["bounds"] = {
                "left": int(rect.left),
                "top": int(rect.top),
                "right": int(rect.right),
                "bottom": int(rect.bottom),
                "width": int(rect.right - rect.left),
                "height": int(rect.bottom - rect.top),
            }
        except Exception as e:
            return {"status": "error", "message": f"Errore attivazione finestra: {e}"}

    return {
        "status": "ok",
        "window_title": chosen["title"],
        "hwnd": hwnd,
        "bounds": chosen["bounds"],
    }


def norm_to_physical_coords(norm_x: int, norm_y: int) -> Tuple[int, int]:
    real_w, real_h = get_physical_screen_size()
    clamped_x = max(0, min(1000, int(norm_x)))
    clamped_y = max(0, min(1000, int(norm_y)))
    phys_x = int((clamped_x / 1000.0) * (real_w - 1))
    phys_y = int((clamped_y / 1000.0) * (real_h - 1))
    return phys_x, phys_y


def click_at_normalized_coords(
    norm_x: int,
    norm_y: int,
    double_click: bool = False,
    text_to_type: Optional[str] = None,
    press_enter: bool = False
) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    try:
        real_x, real_y = norm_to_physical_coords(norm_x, norm_y)
        pyautogui.moveTo(real_x, real_y, duration=0.28)
        if double_click:
            pyautogui.doubleClick(real_x, real_y)
        else:
            pyautogui.click(real_x, real_y)

        if text_to_type:
            time.sleep(0.18)
            pyperclip.copy(text_to_type)
            paste_key = "command" if sys.platform == "darwin" else "ctrl"
            pyautogui.hotkey(paste_key, "v")
            time.sleep(0.25)

        if press_enter:
            pyautogui.press("enter")
            time.sleep(0.35)

        cap = capture_screen_b64(highlight_x=real_x, highlight_y=real_y)
        return {
            "status": "ok",
            "message": f"Clic eseguito a ({real_x}, {real_y}) [norm: {norm_x}, {norm_y}]",
            "real_x": real_x,
            "real_y": real_y,
            **cap,
        }
    except Exception as e:
        cap = capture_screen_b64()
        return {"status": "error", "message": f"Errore clic: {e}", **cap}


def focus_and_paste_into_app(
    window_title_substring: str,
    text_to_paste: str,
    click_norm_x: Optional[int] = None,
    click_norm_y: Optional[int] = None,
    press_enter: bool = True
) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    focus_res = force_activate_window(window_title_substring)
    if focus_res.get("status") != "ok":
        cap = capture_screen_b64()
        return {**focus_res, **cap}

    bounds = focus_res["bounds"]
    real_w, real_h = get_physical_screen_size()

    if click_norm_x is not None and click_norm_y is not None:
        target_x, target_y = norm_to_physical_coords(click_norm_x, click_norm_y)
    else:
        win_left = max(0, bounds["left"])
        win_top = max(0, bounds["top"])
        win_w = min(real_w - win_left, bounds["width"])
        win_h = min(real_h - win_top, bounds["height"])
        target_x = int(win_left + win_w * 0.78)
        target_y = int(win_top + win_h * 0.88)

    try:
        pyperclip.copy(text_to_paste)
        pyautogui.moveTo(target_x, target_y, duration=0.3)
        pyautogui.click(target_x, target_y)
        time.sleep(0.22)

        paste_mod = "command" if sys.platform == "darwin" else "ctrl"
        pyautogui.hotkey(paste_mod, "v")
        time.sleep(0.35)

        if press_enter:
            pyautogui.press("enter")
            time.sleep(0.45)

        cap = capture_screen_b64(highlight_x=target_x, highlight_y=target_y)
        return {
            "status": "ok",
            "message": f"Finestra '{focus_res['window_title']}' attivata e testo incollato a ({target_x}, {target_y}).",
            "window_title": focus_res["window_title"],
            "real_x": target_x,
            "real_y": target_y,
            **cap,
        }
    except Exception as e:
        cap = capture_screen_b64()
        return {"status": "error", "message": f"Errore incollaggio: {e}", **cap}


def open_url_or_app(target: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    try:
        target_clean = target.strip()
        if target_clean.startswith("http://") or target_clean.startswith("https://"):
            webbrowser.open(target_clean)
            time.sleep(1.8)
        else:
            subprocess.Popen(target_clean, shell=True)
            time.sleep(1.5)
        cap = capture_screen_b64()
        return {"status": "ok", "message": f"Aperto target: {target_clean}", **cap}
    except Exception as e:
        cap = capture_screen_b64()
        return {"status": "error", "message": f"Impossibile aprire '{target}': {e}", **cap}


def manage_files(
    action: str,
    path: str,
    content: Optional[str] = None,
    destination: Optional[str] = None
) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    try:
        p = Path(path).expanduser().resolve()
        act = action.lower().strip()
        if act == "list":
            if not p.exists():
                return {"status": "error", "message": f"Percorso non trovato: {p}"}
            items = [
                {"name": item.name, "is_dir": item.is_dir(), "size": item.stat().st_size if item.is_file() else 0}
                for item in list(p.iterdir())[:100]
            ]
            return {"status": "ok", "path": str(p), "items": items}
        elif act == "read":
            text = p.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")
            return {"status": "ok", "path": str(p), "content": text[:15000]}
        elif act == "write":
            p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            p.write_text(content or "", encoding="utf-8")
            return {"status": "ok", "path": str(p), "message": f"Scritto file ({len(content or '')} caratteri)."}
        elif act == "mkdir":
            p.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            return {"status": "ok", "path": str(p), "message": "Cartella creata."}
        elif act == "move" and destination:
            dest_p = Path(destination).expanduser().resolve()
            shutil.move(str(p), str(dest_p))
            return {"status": "ok", "message": f"Spostato in {dest_p}."}
        elif act == "delete":
            if p.is_dir():
                shutil.rmtree(p)
            elif p.exists():
                p.unlink()
            return {"status": "ok", "message": f"Eliminato {p}."}
        return {"status": "error", "message": f"Azione non supportata: {action}"}
    except Exception as e:
        return {"status": "error", "message": f"Errore file system: {e}"}


def run_terminal_command(command: str, cwd: Optional[str] = None) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    try:
        res = subprocess.run(
            command,
            shell=True,
            cwd=cwd or os.getcwd(),
            capture_output=True,
            text=True,
            timeout=25,
            encoding="utf-8",
            errors="replace"
        )
        return {
            "status": "ok" if res.returncode == 0 else "error",
            "returncode": res.returncode,
            "stdout": res.stdout[:8000],
            "stderr": res.stderr[:4000],
        }
    except Exception as e:
        return {"status": "error", "message": f"Errore comando: {e}"}

Handles bots, chats, messages, and initial seeding.

def get_connection() -> sqlite3.Connection:
    """Creates and returns a connection with WAL mode and foreign keys enabled."""
    conn = sqlite3.connect(str(DB_PATH), check_same_thread=False)
    conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
    conn.execute("PRAGMA journal_mode=WAL;")
    conn.execute("PRAGMA foreign_keys=ON;")
    return conn


def init_db() -> None:
    """Initializes tables for bots, chats, and messages."""
    conn = get_connection()
    try:
        with conn:
            conn.execute(
                """
                CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS bots (
                    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
                    name TEXT NOT NULL,
                    role TEXT NOT NULL,
                    system_prompt TEXT NOT NULL,
                    shape TEXT NOT NULL,
                    color TEXT NOT NULL,
                    effort TEXT NOT NULL
                );
                """
            )
            conn.execute(
                """
                CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS chats (
                    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
                    title TEXT NOT NULL,
                    is_group INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
                    participants_json TEXT NOT NULL,
                    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
                );
                """
            )
            conn.execute(
                """
                CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS messages (
                    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
                    chat_id TEXT NOT NULL,
                    sender_id TEXT NOT NULL,
                    sender_name TEXT NOT NULL,
                    content TEXT NOT NULL,
                    action_card_json TEXT,
                    timestamp DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
                    FOREIGN KEY(chat_id) REFERENCES chats(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
                );
                """
            )
            conn.execute(
                "CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_messages_chat_timestamp ON messages(chat_id, timestamp);"
            )
            conn.execute(
                "CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_chats_updated_at ON chats(updated_at);"
            )
    finally:
        conn.close()


def seed_db() -> None:
    """Populates default bots and individual initial chats idempotently."""
    conn = get_connection()
    try:
        with conn:
            for bot in DEFAULT_BOTS:
                conn.execute(
                    """
                    INSERT OR IGNORE INTO bots (id, name, role, system_prompt, shape, color, effort)
                    VALUES (:id, :name, :role, :system_prompt, :shape, :color, :effort);
                    """,
                    bot,
                )
                chat_id = f"chat_{bot['id']}"
                conn.execute(
                    """
                    INSERT OR IGNORE INTO chats (id, title, is_group, participants_json, updated_at)
                    VALUES (?, ?, 0, ?, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP);
                    """,
                    (chat_id, bot["name"], json.dumps([bot["id"]])),
                )
    finally:
        conn.close()


def get_all_bots() -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    """Retrieves all bots from the database."""
    conn = get_connection()
    try:
        cursor = conn.execute(
            "SELECT id, name, role, system_prompt, shape, color, effort FROM bots ORDER BY id ASC;"
        )
        return [dict(row) for row in cursor.fetchall()]
    finally:
        conn.close()


def get_bot(bot_id: str) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
    """Retrieves a single bot by ID."""
    conn = get_connection()
    try:
        cursor = conn.execute(
            "SELECT id, name, role, system_prompt, shape, color, effort FROM bots WHERE id = ?;",
            (bot_id,),
        )
        row = cursor.fetchone()
        return dict(row) if row else None
    finally:
        conn.close()


def create_bot(data: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Creates a new bot record and returns it."""
    bot_id = data.get("id") or str(uuid.uuid4())[:8]
    bot_record = {
        "id": bot_id,
        "name": data["name"],
        "role": data["role"],
        "system_prompt": data["system_prompt"],
        "shape": data.get("shape", "circle"),
        "color": data.get("color", "#00BA88"),
        "effort": data.get("effort", "medium"),
    }
    conn = get_connection()
    try:
        with conn:
            conn.execute(
                """
                INSERT INTO bots (id, name, role, system_prompt, shape, color, effort)
                VALUES (:id, :name, :role, :system_prompt, :shape, :color, :effort);
                """,
                bot_record,
            )
        return bot_record
    finally:
        conn.close()


def get_all_chats() -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    """Retrieves all chats ordered by most recently updated first."""
    conn = get_connection()
    try:
        cursor = conn.execute(
            "SELECT id, title, is_group, participants_json, updated_at FROM chats ORDER BY updated_at DESC;"
        )
        results = []
        for row in cursor.fetchall():
            item = dict(row)
            try:
                item["participants"] = json.loads(item["participants_json"])
            except Exception:
                item["participants"] = []
            results.append(item)
        return results
    finally:
        conn.close()


def get_chat(chat_id: str) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
    """Retrieves a single chat by ID."""
    conn = get_connection()
    try:
        cursor = conn.execute(
            "SELECT id, title, is_group, participants_json, updated_at FROM chats WHERE id = ?;",
            (chat_id,),
        )
        row = cursor.fetchone()
        if not row:
            return None
        item = dict(row)
        try:
            item["participants"] = json.loads(item["participants_json"])
        except Exception:
            item["participants"] = []
        return item
    finally:
        conn.close()


def create_chat(
    title: str,
    participants: list[str],
    is_group: bool = False,
    chat_id: str | None = None,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Creates a new chat and returns its details."""
    if not chat_id:
        chat_id = f"chat_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:12]}"
    participants_json = json.dumps(participants)
    is_group_int = 1 if is_group else 0

    conn = get_connection()
    try:
        with conn:
            conn.execute(
                """
                INSERT INTO chats (id, title, is_group, participants_json, updated_at)
                VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP);
                """,
                (chat_id, title, is_group_int, participants_json),
            )
            cursor = conn.execute(
                "SELECT id, title, is_group, participants_json, updated_at FROM chats WHERE id = ?;",
                (chat_id,),
            )
            row = cursor.fetchone()
            item = dict(row)
            item["participants"] = participants
            return item
    finally:
        conn.close()


def delete_chat(chat_id: str) -> bool:
    """Deletes a chat and its messages completely."""
    conn = get_connection()
    try:
        with conn:
            conn.execute("DELETE FROM messages WHERE chat_id = ?;", (chat_id,))
            cursor = conn.execute("DELETE FROM chats WHERE id = ?;", (chat_id,))
            return cursor.rowcount > 0
    finally:
        conn.close()


def reset_db() -> None:
    """Wipes all chats and messages, re-seeds default bots and clean individual chats."""
    conn = get_connection()
    try:
        with conn:
            conn.execute("DELETE FROM messages;")
            conn.execute("DELETE FROM chats;")
    finally:
        conn.close()
    seed_db()


def add_participant_to_chat(chat_id: str, bot_id: str) -> bool:
    """Adds a participant bot ID to a chat if not already present."""
    conn = get_connection()
    try:
        cursor = conn.execute(
            "SELECT participants_json FROM chats WHERE id = ?;",
            (chat_id,),
        )
        row = cursor.fetchone()
        if not row:
            return False
        try:
            participants = json.loads(row["participants_json"])
        except Exception:
            participants = []

        if bot_id not in participants:
            participants.append(bot_id)
            with conn:
                conn.execute(
                    """
                    UPDATE chats
                    SET participants_json = ?, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
                    WHERE id = ?;
                    """,
                    (json.dumps(participants), chat_id),
                )
            return True
        return False
    finally:
        conn.close()


def save_message(
    chat_id: str,
    sender_id: str,
    sender_name: str,
    content: str,
    action_card_json: str | dict[str, Any] | None = None,
    message_id: str | None = None,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Saves a new message to the chat and updates chat's updated_at timestamp."""
    if not message_id:
        message_id = str(uuid.uuid4())

    if isinstance(action_card_json, dict):
        action_card_str = json.dumps(action_card_json)
    elif isinstance(action_card_json, str):
        action_card_str = action_card_json
    else:
        action_card_str = None

    conn = get_connection()
    try:
        with conn:
            conn.execute(
                """
                INSERT INTO messages (id, chat_id, sender_id, sender_name, content, action_card_json, timestamp)
                VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP);
                """,
                (message_id, chat_id, sender_id, sender_name, content, action_card_str),
            )
            conn.execute(
                "UPDATE chats SET updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = ?;",
                (chat_id,),
            )
            cursor = conn.execute(
                """
                SELECT id, chat_id, sender_id, sender_name, content, action_card_json, timestamp
                FROM messages WHERE id = ?;
                """,
                (message_id,),
            )
            row = cursor.fetchone()
            msg = dict(row)
            if msg.get("action_card_json"):
                try:
                    msg["action_card"] = json.loads(msg["action_card_json"])
                except Exception:
                    msg["action_card"] = None
            else:
                msg["action_card"] = None
            return msg
    finally:
        conn.close()


def get_chat_messages(chat_id: str, limit: int = 50) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    """
    Returns the latest messages for a chat in chronological order (ASC).
    Deserializes action_card_json into action_card field if present.
    """
    conn = get_connection()
    try:
        cursor = conn.execute(
            """
            SELECT id, chat_id, sender_id, sender_name, content, action_card_json, timestamp
            FROM (
                SELECT rowid, id, chat_id, sender_id, sender_name, content, action_card_json, timestamp
                FROM messages
                WHERE chat_id = ?
                ORDER BY timestamp DESC, rowid DESC
                LIMIT ?
            )
            ORDER BY timestamp ASC, rowid ASC;
            """,
            (chat_id, limit),
        )
        messages = []
        for row in cursor.fetchall():
            msg = dict(row)
            if msg.get("action_card_json"):
                try:
                    msg["action_card"] = json.loads(msg["action_card_json"])
                except Exception:
                    msg["action_card"] = None
            else:
                msg["action_card"] = None
            messages.append(msg)
        return messages
    finally:
        conn.close()

--- FILE: electron/main.js ---

const { app, BrowserWindow, ipcMain } = require('electron');
const path = require('path');
const { spawn, execSync } = require('child_process');
const http = require('http');
const fs = require('fs');

let mainWindow = null;
let pythonProcess = null;

function checkBackendReady(url) {
  return new Promise((resolve) => {
    const req = http.get(url, (res) => {
      resolve(res.statusCode === 200);
    });
    req.on('error', () => resolve(false));
    req.setTimeout(1000, () => {
      req.destroy();
      resolve(false);
    });
  });
}

async function startPythonBackend() {
  const isAlreadyRunning = await checkBackendReady('http://127.0.0.1:8000/api/bootstrap');
  if (isAlreadyRunning) return;

  const backendDir = path.join(__dirname, '..', 'backend');
  const venvWin = path.join(backendDir, '.venv', 'Scripts', 'python.exe');
  const venvAlt = path.join(backendDir, 'venv', 'Scripts', 'python.exe');
  let pythonExe = 'python';
  if (fs.existsSync(venvWin)) pythonExe = venvWin;
  else if (fs.existsSync(venvAlt)) pythonExe = venvAlt;

  pythonProcess = spawn(
    pythonExe,
    ['-m', 'uvicorn', 'main:app', '--host', '127.0.0.1', '--port', '8000'],
    {
      cwd: backendDir,
      windowsHide: true,
      env: { ...process.env, PYTHONIOENCODING: 'utf-8' },
    }
  );

  for (let i = 0; i < 30; i++) {
    const ready = await checkBackendReady('http://127.0.0.1:8000/api/bootstrap');
    if (ready) break;
    await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 350));
  }
}

function createWindow() {
  mainWindow = new BrowserWindow({
    width: 1320,
    height: 860,
    minWidth: 980,
    minHeight: 640,
    backgroundColor: '#F8F8F7',
    titleBarStyle: 'hidden',
    titleBarOverlay: {
      color: '#FFFFFF',
      symbolColor: '#1F2937',
      height: 44,
    },
    autoHideMenuBar: true,
    webPreferences: {
      preload: path.join(__dirname, 'preload.js'),
      contextIsolation: true,
      nodeIntegration: false,
    },
  });

  const distIndex = path.join(__dirname, '..', 'frontend', 'dist', 'index.html');
  if (fs.existsSync(distIndex)) {
    mainWindow.loadFile(distIndex);
  } else {
    mainWindow.loadURL('http://localhost:5173');
  }
}

ipcMain.on('window-minimize', () => mainWindow?.minimize());
ipcMain.on('window-maximize', () => {
  if (!mainWindow) return;
  if (mainWindow.isMaximized()) mainWindow.unmaximize();
  else mainWindow.maximize();
});
ipcMain.on('window-close', () => mainWindow?.close());

app.whenReady().then(async () => {
  await startPythonBackend();
  createWindow();
});

app.on('will-quit', () => {
  if (pythonProcess && pythonProcess.pid) {
    try {
      if (process.platform === 'win32') {
        execSync(`taskkill /pid ${pythonProcess.pid} /T /F`);
      } else {
        pythonProcess.kill('SIGTERM');
      }
    } catch (_) {}
  }
});

app.on('window-all-closed', () => {
  if (process.platform !== 'darwin') app.quit();
});

import React, { useState, useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import {
  Plus, Search, Settings, Monitor, Send, CheckCircle2,
  Loader2, X, Camera, FolderOpen, Key, RefreshCw, ExternalLink
} from 'lucide-react';
import BlobAvatar from './components/BlobAvatar';

const API_BASE = 'http://127.0.0.1:8000';
const WS_BASE = 'ws://127.0.0.1:8000';

export default function App() {
  const [bots, setBots] = useState([]);
  const [chats, setChats] = useState([]);
  const [activeChatId, setActiveChatId] = useState('chat_chief');
  const [messages, setMessages] = useState([]);
  const [inputText, setInputText] = useState('');
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState('');
  const [botStatuses, setBotStatuses] = useState({});
  const [isSending, setIsSending] = useState(false);

  const [showNewModal, setShowNewModal] = useState(false);
  const [newModalTab, setNewModalTab] = useState('chat');
  const [showSettingsModal, setShowSettingsModal] = useState(false);
  const [showInspectorModal, setShowInspectorModal] = useState(false);
  const [showAttachMenu, setShowAttachMenu] = useState(false);

  const [apiKeyInput, setApiKeyInput] = useState('');
  const [maskedKey, setMaskedKey] = useState('');
  const [newChatTitle, setNewChatTitle] = useState('');
  const [selectedBotIds, setSelectedBotIds] = useState(['chief', 'architect', 'builder']);
  const [newBotName, setNewBotName] = useState('');
  const [newBotRole, setNewBotRole] = useState('');
  const [newBotPrompt, setNewBotPrompt] = useState('');
  const [newBotShape, setNewBotShape] = useState('squircle');
  const [newBotColor, setNewBotColor] = useState('#10B981');

  const [inspectorData, setInspectorData] = useState(null);
  const [inspectorWindows, setInspectorWindows] = useState([]);
  const [loadingInspector, setLoadingInspector] = useState(false);

  const messagesEndRef = useRef(null);
  const wsRef = useRef(null);
  const fileInputRef = useRef(null);

  const botsMap = React.useMemo(() => {
    const map = {};
    bots.forEach((b) => { map[b.id] = b; });
    return map;
  }, [bots]);

  const activeChat = React.useMemo(
    () => chats.find((c) => c.id === activeChatId) || chats[0] || null,
    [chats, activeChatId]
  );

  const fetchBootstrap = async () => {
    try {
      const res = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/api/bootstrap`);
      const data = await res.json();
      setBots(data.bots || []);
      setChats(data.chats || []);
      if (data.chats?.length && !data.chats.find((c) => c.id === activeChatId)) {
        setActiveChatId(data.chats[0].id);
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Bootstrap error:', err);
    }
  };

  const fetchMessages = async (chatId) => {
    if (!chatId) return;
    try {
      const res = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/api/chats/${chatId}/messages`);
      const data = await res.json();
      setMessages(Array.isArray(data) ? data : []);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Messages error:', err);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    fetchBootstrap();
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!activeChatId) return;
    fetchMessages(activeChatId);

    if (wsRef.current) {
      wsRef.current.close();
    }
    const ws = new WebSocket(`${WS_BASE}/ws/${activeChatId}`);
    wsRef.current = ws;

    ws.onmessage = (event) => {
      try {
        const payload = JSON.parse(event.data);
        if (payload.type === 'new_message' && payload.message) {
          setMessages((prev) => {
            if (prev.some((m) => m.id === payload.message.id)) return prev;
            return [...prev, payload.message];
          });
          fetchBootstrap();
        } else if (payload.type === 'bot_status') {
          setBotStatuses((prev) => ({
            ...prev,
            [payload.bot_id]: payload.status === 'idle' ? null : {
              name: payload.bot_name || payload.bot_id,
              status: payload.status,
            },
          }));
        }
      } catch (e) {
        console.error('WS parse error:', e);
      }
    };

    return () => ws.close();
  }, [activeChatId]);

  useEffect(() => {
    messagesEndRef.current?.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });
  }, [messages, botStatuses]);

  const handleSendMessage = async (customText = null) => {
    const text = (customText !== null ? customText : inputText).trim();
    if (!text || !activeChatId || isSending) return;
    if (customText === null) setInputText('');
    setIsSending(true);

    try {
      const res = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/api/chats/${activeChatId}/messages`, {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({ content: text }),
      });
      const data = await res.json();
      if (data.bot_replies) {
        await fetchMessages(activeChatId);
        await fetchBootstrap();
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Send error:', err);
    } finally {
      setIsSending(false);
      setBotStatuses({});
    }
  };

  const openInspector = async () => {
    setShowInspectorModal(true);
    setLoadingInspector(true);
    try {
      const [capRes, winRes] = await Promise.all([
        fetch(`${API_BASE}/api/os/screenshot`),
        fetch(`${API_BASE}/api/os/windows`),
      ]);
      setInspectorData(await capRes.json());
      const winJson = await winRes.json();
      setInspectorWindows(winJson.windows || []);
    } catch (e) {
      console.error(e);
    } finally {
      setLoadingInspector(false);
    }
  };

  const openSettings = async () => {
    setShowSettingsModal(true);
    try {
      const res = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/api/settings`);
      const data = await res.json();
      setMaskedKey(data.masked_key || '');
    } catch (_) {}
  };

  const handleSaveApiKey = async () => {
    if (!apiKeyInput.trim()) return;
    await fetch(`${API_BASE}/api/settings/apikey`, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify({ api_key: apiKeyInput.trim() }),
    });
    setApiKeyInput('');
    setShowSettingsModal(false);
    fetchBootstrap();
  };

  const handleCreateChat = async () => {
    if (!newChatTitle.trim() || selectedBotIds.length === 0) return;
    const res = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/api/chats`, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify({ title: newChatTitle.trim(), participants: selectedBotIds }),
    });
    const data = await res.json();
    await fetchBootstrap();
    if (data.chat?.id) setActiveChatId(data.chat.id);
    setNewChatTitle('');
    setShowNewModal(false);
  };

  const handleCreateBot = async () => {
    if (!newBotName.trim() || !newBotRole.trim()) return;
    const res = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/api/bots`, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify({
        name: newBotName.trim(),
        role: newBotRole.trim(),
        system_prompt: newBotPrompt.trim(),
        shape: newBotShape,
        color: newBotColor,
      }),
    });
    const data = await res.json();
    await fetchBootstrap();
    if (data.chat?.id) setActiveChatId(data.chat.id);
    setNewBotName('');
    setNewBotRole('');
    setNewBotPrompt('');
    setShowNewModal(false);
  };

  const activeWorkingBots = Object.entries(botStatuses)
    .filter(([, val]) => val !== null)
    .map(([id, val]) => ({ id, ...val }));

  const filteredChats = chats.filter((c) =>
    (c.title || '').toLowerCase().includes(searchQuery.toLowerCase())
  );

  return (
    <div className="flex h-screen w-screen overflow-hidden bg-[#FFFFFF] text-[#111827] select-none font-sans">
      <aside className="w-[290px] bg-[#F8F8F7] border-r border-gray-200 flex flex-col h-full shrink-0">
        <div
          className="h-12 px-4 flex items-center justify-between border-b border-gray-200/70"
          style={{ WebkitAppRegion: 'drag' }}
        >
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2" style={{ WebkitAppRegion: 'no-drag' }}>
            <button
              onClick={() => window.electronAPI?.close?.()}
              className="w-3 h-3 rounded-full bg-[#FF5F56] hover:opacity-80 cursor-pointer"
              title="Chiudi"
            />
            <button
              onClick={() => window.electronAPI?.minimize?.()}
              className="w-3 h-3 rounded-full bg-[#FFBD2E] hover:opacity-80 cursor-pointer"
              title="Riduci a icona"
            />
            <button
              onClick={() => window.electronAPI?.maximize?.()}
              className="w-3 h-3 rounded-full bg-[#27C93F] hover:opacity-80 cursor-pointer"
              title="Ingrandisci"
            />
          </div>

          <button
            onClick={() => setShowNewModal(true)}
            style={{ WebkitAppRegion: 'no-drag' }}
            className="p-1.5 rounded-lg hover:bg-gray-200/80 text-gray-700 transition cursor-pointer z-50"
            title="Nuovo Coworker o Stanza (+)"
          >
            <Plus className="w-5 h-5" />

import React from 'react';
import { motion } from 'framer-motion';
import { DEFAULT_BOT_PILE } from './blobPresets.js';

/**
 * Returns the base center coordinate (cx, cy) for the eyes in a 100x100 viewBox
 * depending on the blob shape geometry.
 */
function getBaseEyePosition(shape) {
  switch (shape) {
    case 'drop':
      // The drop is fat on bottom-left and tapers to top-right
      return { x: 38, y: 58 };
    case 'triangle':
      // Triangle narrows at the apex; center-belly is slightly lower
      return { x: 50, y: 50 };
    case 'cylinder':
      return { x: 52, y: 46 };
    case 'cloud':
    case 'squircle':
    case 'circle':
    default:
      // Iconic slightly off-center Grok mascot placement
      return { x: 55, y: 45 };
  }
}

/**
 * Directional offsets for where the eyes look.
 */
const LOOK_OFFSETS = {
  right: { x: 5, y: 0 },
  left: { x: -5, y: 0 },
  up: { x: 0, y: -4 },
  down: { x: 0, y: 4 },
  center: { x: 0, y: 0 },
};

/**
 * Renders the SVG shape path based on the shape prop.
 */
function BlobShape({ shape, color }) {
  switch (shape) {
    case 'squircle':
      return (
        <rect
          x="8"
          y="8"
          width="84"
          height="84"
          rx="28"
          fill={color}
        />
      );

    case 'triangle':
      return (
        <path
          d="M50 10 C62 10, 90 68, 86 82 C82 94, 18 94, 14 82 C10 68, 38 10, 50 10 Z"
          fill={color}
        />
      );

    case 'cloud':
      return (
        <path
          d="M 81.2 32.0 A 22 22 0 0 1 81.2 68.0 A 22 22 0 0 1 50.0 86.0 A 22 22 0 0 1 18.8 68.0 A 22 22 0 0 1 18.8 32.0 A 22 22 0 0 1 50.0 14.0 A 22 22 0 0 1 81.2 32.0 Z"
          fill={color}
        />
      );

    case 'cylinder':
      return (
        <rect
          x="14"
          y="10"
          width="72"
          height="80"
          rx="22"
          fill={color}
        />
      );

    case 'drop':
      return (
        <path
          d="M 76 16 C 82 22, 88 44, 84 64 C 80 80, 64 90, 44 90 C 24 90, 12 78, 12 58 C 12 38, 28 22, 52 14 C 64 10, 72 12, 76 16 Z"
          fill={color}
        />
      );

    case 'circle':
    default:
      return (
        <circle
          cx="50"
          cy="50"
          r="44"
          fill={color}
        />
      );
  }
}

/**
 * BlobAvatar Component
 * Playful, animated vector mascot inspired by Grok.
 */
export function BlobAvatar({
  shape = 'circle',
  color = '#FF5C35',
  size = 40,
  status = 'idle',
  tilt = 0,
  lookDirection = 'right',
  className = '',
  onClick,
}) {
  // Base tilt compensation (cylinders lean 15 deg by default)
  const effectiveTilt = (Number(tilt) || 0) + (shape === 'cylinder' ? 15 : 0);

  // Look direction & eye coordinates calculation
  const baseEye = getBaseEyePosition(shape);
  const lookOffset = LOOK_OFFSETS[lookDirection] || LOOK_OFFSETS.right;
  const targetEyeX = baseEye.x + lookOffset.x;
  const targetEyeY = baseEye.y + lookOffset.y;

  // Active status checks
  const isBusy = status === 'working' || status === 'typing';
  const isDone = status === 'done';

  // Dimension formatting (handles numbers, px, rem, or Tailwind classes)
  const numericSize =
    typeof size === 'number'
      ? size
      : !isNaN(Number(size))
      ? Number(size)
      : null;

  const styleDimension =
    numericSize !== null
      ? { width: `${numericSize}px`, height: `${numericSize}px` }
      : typeof size === 'string' && /px|rem|em|%|vw|vh/.test(size)
      ? { width: size, height: size }
      : undefined;

  // Animation variants for the outer body group
  const bodyAnimation = isBusy
    ? {
        rotate: [effectiveTilt - 5, effectiveTilt + 5, effectiveTilt - 5],
        y: [0, -1.5, 0],
      }
    : isDone
    ? {
        rotate: [effectiveTilt, effectiveTilt - 4, effectiveTilt + 4, effectiveTilt],
        scale: [1, 1.08, 0.96, 1],
        y: [0, -5, 1, 0],
      }
    : {
        rotate: effectiveTilt,
        y: [0, -1.5, 0],
      };

  const bodyTransition = isBusy
    ? {
        repeat: Infinity,
        duration: 1.2,
        ease: 'easeInOut',
      }
    : isDone
    ? {
        duration: 0.6,
        ease: 'easeOut',
      }
    : {
        repeat: Infinity,
        duration: 3.5,
        ease: 'easeInOut',
      };

  // Eyes animation (curious scanning left/right when busy)
  const eyeGroupAnimation = isBusy
    ? {
        x: [targetEyeX - 4, targetEyeX + 5, targetEyeX - 2, targetEyeX],
        y: targetEyeY,
      }
    : {
        x: targetEyeX,
        y: targetEyeY,
      };

  const eyeGroupTransition = isBusy
    ? {
        repeat: Infinity,
        duration: 1.6,
        ease: 'easeInOut',
      }
    : {
        type: 'spring',
        stiffness: 280,
        damping: 20,
      };

  return (
    <motion.svg
      viewBox="0 0 100 100"
      width={numericSize || undefined}
      height={numericSize || undefined}
      style={styleDimension}
      className={`inline-block select-none overflow-visible filter drop-shadow-[0_4px_8px_rgba(0,0,0,0.12)] ${
        onClick ? 'cursor-pointer' : ''
      } ${className}`}
      onClick={onClick}
      whileHover={onClick ? { scale: 1.08 } : undefined}
      whileTap={onClick ? { scale: 0.94 } : undefined}
      role="img"
      aria-label={`${shape} mascot in ${status} status`}
    >
      {/* Animated Body Group */}
      <motion.g
        style={{ transformOrigin: '50px 50px' }}
        animate={bodyAnimation}
        transition={bodyTransition}
      >
        {/* Vector Mascot Silhouette */}
        <BlobShape shape={shape} color={color} />

        {/* Eye Cluster Group */}
        <motion.g
          animate={eyeGroupAnimation}
          transition={eyeGroupTransition}
        >
          {/* Natural Grok Pill Angle (-11deg) */}
          <g transform="rotate(-11)">
            {/* Periodic Blink Animation Container */}
            <motion.g
              animate={{ scaleY: [1, 0.08, 1] }}
              transition={{
                duration: 0.18,
                times: [0, 0.5, 1],
                repeat: Infinity,
                repeatDelay: 3.5,
                ease: 'easeInOut',
              }}
              style={{ transformOrigin: '0px 0px' }}
            >
              {/* Left Eye Pill */}
              <rect
                x="-11.5"
                y="-11"
                width="9"
                height="22"
                rx="4.5"
                fill="#FFFFFF"
              />
              {/* Right Eye Pill */}
              <rect
                x="2.5"
                y="-11"
                width="9"
                height="22"
                rx="4.5"
                fill="#FFFFFF"
              />
            </motion.g>
          </g>
        </motion.g>
      </motion.g>
    </motion.svg>
  );
}

/**
 * BotPile Component
 * Stacks a playful pile/cluster of Grok companion bots overlapping like stickers.
 */
export function BotPile({
  bots = DEFAULT_BOT_PILE,
  className = '',
  onBotClick,
}) {
  const botList = bots && bots.length > 0 ? bots : DEFAULT_BOT_PILE;

  return (
    <div
      className={`relative inline-flex items-end justify-center select-none -space-x-4 sm:-space-x-5 py-3 px-2 ${className}`}
    >
      {botList.map((bot, index) => {
        const isInteractive = Boolean(onBotClick);
        return (
          <motion.div
            key={bot.id || `bot-pile-${index}`}
            className={`relative transition-transform ${
              isInteractive ? 'cursor-pointer' : ''
            }`}
            style={{ zIndex: index + 1 }}
            whileHover={{
              y: -8,
              scale: 1.14,
              zIndex: 40,
              transition: { type: 'spring', stiffness: 350, damping: 18 },
            }}
            whileTap={isInteractive ? { scale: 0.94 } : undefined}
            onClick={() => onBotClick?.(bot, index)}
          >
            <BlobAvatar
              shape={bot.shape}
              color={bot.color}
              size={bot.size}
              tilt={bot.tilt}
              lookDirection={bot.lookDirection}
              status={bot.status || 'idle'}
              className="drop-shadow-md"
            />
          </motion.div>
        );
      })}
    </div>
  );
}

export default BlobAvatar;

/**
 * Returns a randomized cute blob configuration.
 */
export function getRandomBlob(overrides = {}) {
  const randomColor = BLOB_COLOR_LIST[Math.floor(Math.random() * BLOB_COLOR_LIST.length)];
  const randomShape = BLOB_SHAPES[Math.floor(Math.random() * BLOB_SHAPES.length)];
  const randomDirection = LOOK_DIRECTIONS[Math.floor(Math.random() * LOOK_DIRECTIONS.length)];
  const randomTilt = Math.floor(Math.random() * 32) - 16; // -16 to +16 deg

  return {
    shape: randomShape,
    color: randomColor,
    tilt: randomTilt,
    lookDirection: randomDirection,
    status: 'idle',
    size: 48,
    ...overrides,
  };
}

/**
 * Retrieve a preset configuration by role name.
 */
export function getBotByRole(role, overrides = {}) {
  const base = ROLE_PRESETS[role] || ROLE_PRESETS.assistant;
  return { ...base, ...overrides };
}

import React, { useState, useRef, useEffect } from 'react';

/**
 * Lightweight safe markdown renderer
 */
function MarkdownContent({ content = '' }) {
  const [copiedCodeIdx, setCopiedCodeIdx] = useState(null);

  if (!content) return null;

  const copyToClipboard = (text, idx) => {
    navigator.clipboard?.writeText(text);
    setCopiedCodeIdx(idx);
    setTimeout(() => setCopiedCodeIdx(null), 1800);
  };

  // Split by code blocks first
  const parts = content.split(/(```[\s\S]*?```)/g);

  return (
    <div className="space-y-2 text-[14.5px] leading-relaxed text-gray-800 break-words font-sans">
      {parts.map((part, index) => {
        if (part.startsWith('```') && part.endsWith('```')) {
          const lines = part.slice(3, -3).trim().split('\n');
          const firstLine = lines[0].trim();
          const hasLang = !firstLine.includes(' ') && firstLine.length > 0 && firstLine.length < 15;
          const language = hasLang ? firstLine : '';
          const codeBody = hasLang ? lines.slice(1).join('\n') : lines.join('\n');

          return (
            <div
              key={index}
              className="my-2.5 rounded-xl bg-[#1E1E24] text-gray-200 border border-gray-800/80 overflow-hidden font-mono text-xs shadow-xs"
            >
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between px-3.5 py-1.5 bg-[#17171C] border-b border-gray-800 text-[11px] text-gray-400">
                <span>{language || 'code'}</span>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => copyToClipboard(codeBody, index)}
                  className="flex items-center gap-1 hover:text-white transition-colors"
                >
                  {copiedCodeIdx === index ? (
                    <>
                      <Check className="w-3 h-3 text-emerald-400" />
                      <span className="text-emerald-400">Copied</span>
                    </>
                  ) : (
                    <>
                      <Copy className="w-3 h-3" />
                      <span>Copy</span>
                    </>
                  )}
                </button>
              </div>
              <pre className="p-3.5 overflow-x-auto leading-5 text-[12px]">{codeBody}</pre>
            </div>
          );
        }

        // Normal text formatting: bullet lists, bold, inline code, paragraphs
        const paragraphs = part.split(/\n\n+/);
        return paragraphs.map((para, pIdx) => {
          const lines = para.split('\n');
          return (
            <p key={`${index}-${pIdx}`} className="leading-relaxed">
              {lines.map((line, lIdx) => {
                const isBullet = line.trim().startsWith('- ') || line.trim().startsWith('* ');
                const isNumbered = /^\d+\.\s/.test(line.trim());

                // Parse bold and inline code
                const formattedSegments = line
                  .replace(/^[*-]\s+/, 'â€¢ ')
                  .split(/(\*\*.*?\*\*|`.*?`)/g)
                  .map((seg, sIdx) => {
                    if (seg.startsWith('**') && seg.endsWith('**')) {
                      return (
                        <strong key={sIdx} className="font-semibold text-gray-900">
                          {seg.slice(2, -2)}
                        </strong>
                      );
                    }
                    if (seg.startsWith('`') && seg.endsWith('`')) {
                      return (
                        <code
                          key={sIdx}
                          className="px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded-md bg-gray-100 text-pink-600 font-mono text-[12.5px] border border-gray-200/60"
                        >
                          {seg.slice(1, -1)}
                        </code>
                      );
                    }
                    return seg;
                  });

                return (
                  <span
                    key={lIdx}
                    className={`block ${isBullet || isNumbered ? 'pl-2 text-gray-800' : ''}`}
                  >
                    {formattedSegments}
                  </span>
                );
              })}
            </p>
          );
        });
      })}
    </div>
  );
}

            { x: 38, y: 8, rotate: 10 },
          ];
          const offset = offsets[idx] || { x: 0, y: 0, rotate: 0 };

          return (
            <motion.div
              key={b.id || idx}
              initial={{ scale: 0, y: 20 }}
              animate={{ scale: 1, y: offset.y, x: offset.x, rotate: offset.rotate }}
              transition={{
                delay: idx * 0.1,

                stiffness: 260,

      </div>

      <motion.h3

        className="text-xl font-bold text-gray-900 tracking-tight"

        initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 6 }}
