                >
                  <Sparkles className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                  Create Bot
                </button>
              </div>
            </form>
          </motion.div>
        </div>
      )}
    </AnimatePresence>
  );
}


// === FILE: frontend\src\components\NewRoomModal.jsx ===

import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { motion, AnimatePresence } from 'framer-motion';
import { X, Users, Check, Hash, CheckSquare, Square } from 'lucide-react';
import BlobAvatar from './BlobAvatar';

/**
 * Fallback-safe BlobAvatar renderer
 */
const SafeBlobAvatar = ({ shape = 'circle', color = '#358BFF', size = 32, status = 'idle', className = '' }) => {
  if (!BlobAvatar) {
    return (
      <div
        className={`rounded-full flex items-center justify-center font-bold text-white text-xs shadow-xs ${className}`}
        style={{ width: size, height: size, backgroundColor: color }}
      >
        <Users className="w-4 h-4 text-white" />
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <BlobAvatar
      shape={shape}
      color={color}
      size={size}
      status={status}
      className={className}
    />
  );
};

// Helper to create IDs outside component render flow
function generateRoomId() {
  return `room-${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 8)}`;
}

function getTimestamp() {
  return new Date().toISOString();
}

// Default sample bots in case none are passed yet
const DEFAULT_SAMPLE_BOTS = [
  { id: 'bot-chief', name: 'Chief', role: 'Tech Lead & Orchestrator', shape: 'squircle', color: '#FF5C35', status: 'idle' },
  { id: 'bot-architect', name: 'Architect', role: 'System & DB Architecture', shape: 'cylinder', color: '#358BFF', status: 'idle' },
  { id: 'bot-builder', name: 'Builder', role: 'Code generation & refactor', shape: 'triangle', color: '#10B981', status: 'working' },
  { id: 'bot-designer', name: 'Designer', role: 'UI/UX & Micro-interactions', shape: 'cloud', color: '#9B51E0', status: 'idle' },
  { id: 'bot-scout', name: 'Scout', role: 'Research & Knowledge retrieval', shape: 'drop', color: '#FFC700', status: 'idle' },
];

export default function NewRoomModal({
  isOpen = false,
  onClose,
  onCreateRoom,
  availableBots = [],
}) {
  const botsList = availableBots && availableBots.length > 0 ? availableBots : DEFAULT_SAMPLE_BOTS;

  const [roomName, setRoomName] = useState('');
  const [description, setDescription] = useState('');
  const [selectedBotIds, setSelectedBotIds] = useState(() => botsList.slice(0, 2).map((b) => b.id));

  // Handle escape key
  useEffect(() => {
    const handleKeyDown = (e) => {
      if (e.key === 'Escape' && isOpen) {
        onClose?.();
      }
    };
    window.addEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
  }, [isOpen, onClose]);

  const toggleBotSelection = (botId) => {
    setSelectedBotIds((prev) =>
      prev.includes(botId) ? prev.filter((id) => id !== botId) : [...prev, botId]
    );
  };

  const toggleSelectAll = () => {
    if (selectedBotIds.length === botsList.length) {
      setSelectedBotIds([]);
    } else {
      setSelectedBotIds(botsList.map((b) => b.id));
    }
  };

  const selectedBots = botsList.filter((b) => selectedBotIds.includes(b.id));

  const resetForm = () => {
    setRoomName('');
    setDescription('');
    setSelectedBotIds(botsList.slice(0, 2).map((b) => b.id));
  };

  const handleClose = () => {
    resetForm();
    onClose?.();
  };

  const handleCreate = (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!roomName.trim()) return;

    const roomId = generateRoomId();
    const newRoom = {
      id: roomId,
      name: roomName.trim(),
      description: description.trim(),
      isRoom: true,
      type: 'room',
      bots: selectedBots,
      botIds: selectedBotIds,
      createdAt: getTimestamp(),
      status: selectedBots.some((b) => b.status === 'working' || b.status === 'typing')
        ? 'working'
        : 'idle',
      lastMessage: {
        text: `Room created with ${selectedBots.length} bots: ${selectedBots.map((b) => b.name).join(', ')}`,
        time: 'Just now',
      },
    };

    if (onCreateRoom) {
      onCreateRoom(newRoom);
    }
    resetForm();
    if (onClose) {
      onClose();
    }
  };

  return (
    <AnimatePresence>
      {isOpen && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4">
          {/* Backdrop */}
          <motion.div
            initial={{ opacity: 0 }}
            animate={{ opacity: 1 }}
            exit={{ opacity: 0 }}
            onClick={handleClose}
            className="fixed inset-0 bg-black/40 backdrop-blur-xs transition-opacity"
          />

          {/* Modal Content Card */}
          <motion.div
            initial={{ opacity: 0, scale: 0.94, y: 12 }}
            animate={{ opacity: 1, scale: 1, y: 0 }}
            exit={{ opacity: 0, scale: 0.94, y: 12 }}
            transition={{ type: 'spring', duration: 0.35, bounce: 0.15 }}
            className="relative w-full max-w-lg bg-white rounded-3xl shadow-2xl border border-gray-100 overflow-hidden z-10 flex flex-col"
          >
            {/* Header */}
            <div className="px-6 pt-5 pb-3 flex items-center justify-between border-b border-gray-100">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <div className="w-7 h-7 rounded-lg bg-blue-50 text-blue-600 flex items-center justify-center">
                  <Users className="w-4 h-4" />
                </div>
                <h3 className="text-base font-semibold text-gray-900">Create Collaborative Room</h3>
              </div>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={handleClose}
                className="w-7 h-7 rounded-lg flex items-center justify-center text-gray-400 hover:text-gray-700 hover:bg-gray-100 transition"
              >
                <X className="w-4 h-4" />
              </button>
            </div>

            <form onSubmit={handleCreate} className="px-6 py-5 flex flex-col gap-4 overflow-y-auto max-h-[82vh]">
              {/* Room Name */}
              <div>
                <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-gray-700 mb-1 flex items-center gap-1">
                  <Hash className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-gray-400" />
                  Room Name <span className="text-red-500">*</span>
                </label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  required
                  placeholder="e.g. Offsite Crew, Sprint 42, Architecture"
                  value={roomName}
                  onChange={(e) => setRoomName(e.target.value)}
                  className="w-full text-sm px-3 py-2 rounded-xl border border-gray-200 focus:border-black focus:ring-1 focus:ring-black outline-none transition bg-white"
                />
              </div>

              {/* Room Description */}
              <div>
                <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-gray-700 mb-1">
                  Purpose / Topic (Optional)
                </label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  placeholder="e.g. Cross-functional space for autonomous task execution"
                  value={description}
                  onChange={(e) => setDescription(e.target.value)}
                  className="w-full text-sm px-3 py-2 rounded-xl border border-gray-200 focus:border-black focus:ring-1 focus:ring-black outline-none transition bg-white"
                />
              </div>

              {/* Bot Selection Section */}
              <div>
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-2">
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                    <span className="text-xs font-semibold text-gray-700">
                      Add Bots to Room
                    </span>
                    <span className="text-[11px] font-medium px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-blue-50 text-blue-700 border border-blue-200/50">
                      {selectedBotIds.length} of {botsList.length} selected
                    </span>
                  </div>

                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={toggleSelectAll}
                    className="text-xs text-blue-600 hover:text-blue-800 font-medium flex items-center gap-1"
                  >
                    {selectedBotIds.length === botsList.length ? (
                      <>
                        <CheckSquare className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> Deselect All
                      </>
                    ) : (
                      <>
                        <Square className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> Select All
                      </>
                    )}
                  </button>
                </div>

                {/* Selected Avatars Cluster Preview */}
                {selectedBots.length > 0 && (
                  <div className="mb-2 p-2.5 rounded-xl bg-stone-50 border border-stone-200/60 flex items-center justify-between">
                    <div className="flex items-center -space-x-2 overflow-hidden py-0.5 pl-1">
                      {selectedBots.map((b) => (
                        <div
                          key={b.id}
                          className="rounded-full ring-2 ring-white shadow-xs"
                          title={`${b.name} (${b.role})`}
                        >
                          <SafeBlobAvatar
                            shape={b.shape}
                            color={b.color}
                            size={28}
                            status={b.status}
                          />
                        </div>
                      ))}
                    </div>
                    <span className="text-[11px] text-gray-500 font-medium truncate max-w-[200px]">
                      {selectedBots.map((b) => b.name).join(', ')}
                    </span>
                  </div>
                )}

                {/* Bots List */}
                <div className="border border-gray-200 rounded-2xl overflow-hidden divide-y divide-gray-100 max-h-52 overflow-y-auto">
                  {botsList.map((bot) => {
                    const isSelected = selectedBotIds.includes(bot.id);
                    return (
                      <div
                        key={bot.id}
                        onClick={() => toggleBotSelection(bot.id)}
                        className={`flex items-center justify-between px-3.5 py-2.5 cursor-pointer transition-colors ${
                          isSelected ? 'bg-stone-50/80 hover:bg-stone-100/80' : 'hover:bg-gray-50'
                        }`}
                      >
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-3 min-w-0">
                          <SafeBlobAvatar
                            shape={bot.shape}
                            color={bot.color}
                            size={34}
                            status={bot.status}
                          />
                          <div className="flex flex-col min-w-0">
                            <span className="text-sm font-semibold text-gray-900 truncate">
                              {bot.name}
                            </span>
                            <span className="text-xs text-gray-500 truncate">
                              {bot.role}
                            </span>
                          </div>
                        </div>

                        {/* Checkbox box */}
                        <div
                          className={`w-5 h-5 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center transition-all shrink-0 ml-2 ${
                            isSelected
                              ? 'bg-black text-white'
                              : 'border border-gray-300 bg-white'
                          }`}
                        >
                          {isSelected && <Check className="w-3.5 h-3.5 stroke-[2.5]" />}
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    );
                  })}
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* Action Buttons */}
              <div className="pt-2 flex items-center justify-end gap-2.5 border-t border-gray-100">
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={handleClose}
                  className="px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium text-gray-600 hover:text-gray-900 rounded-xl hover:bg-gray-100 transition"
                >
                  Cancel
                </button>
                <button
                  type="submit"
                  disabled={!roomName.trim() || selectedBotIds.length === 0}
                  className="bg-black text-white hover:bg-stone-800 disabled:opacity-40 disabled:cursor-not-allowed rounded-xl px-5 py-2 text-sm font-medium transition shadow-xs flex items-center gap-1.5"
                >
                  <Users className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                  Create Room
                </button>
              </div>
            </form>
          </motion.div>
        </div>
      )}
    </AnimatePresence>
  );
}


// === FILE: frontend\src\components\SettingsModal.jsx ===

import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { motion } from 'framer-motion';
import {
  X,
  Key,
  User,
  Trash2,
  Check,
  AlertTriangle,
  RefreshCw,
  ExternalLink,
  Lock,
  Cpu,
  Power,
  Loader2,
} from 'lucide-react';
import {
  getSettings,
  saveApiKey,
  resetDatabase,
  getModelStatus,
  setModelProvider,
  startLocalModel,
  stopLocalModel,
} from '../services/api';

export default function SettingsModal({
  isOpen,
  onClose,
  currentUserName = 'Costa',
  onUpdateUserName,
  onDatabaseReset,
}) {
  const [apiKey, setApiKey] = useState('');
  const [userName, setUserName] = useState(currentUserName);
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(false);
  const [statusMessage, setStatusMessage] = useState(null); // { type: 'success' | 'error', text: '' }
  const [isResetConfirmOpen, setIsResetConfirmOpen] = useState(false);
  const [modelStatus, setModelStatus] = useState(null);
  const [providerMode, setProviderMode] = useState('AUTO');
  const [isModelActionLoading, setIsModelActionLoading] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isOpen) return;
    setUserName(currentUserName);
    setStatusMessage(null);
    setIsResetConfirmOpen(false);

    async function loadSettings() {
      try {
        setIsLoading(true);
        const [data, statusData] = await Promise.all([
          getSettings(),
          getModelStatus().catch(() => null),
        ]);
        if (data?.gemini_api_key) {
          setApiKey(data.gemini_api_key);
        }
        if (statusData) {
          setModelStatus(statusData);
          if (statusData.provider_mode) {
            setProviderMode(statusData.provider_mode);
          }
        }
      } catch (err) {
        console.warn('Failed to load settings:', err);
      } finally {
        setIsLoading(false);
      }
    }
    loadSettings();
  }, [isOpen, currentUserName]);

  const handleSetProvider = async (mode) => {
    try {
      setIsModelActionLoading(true);
      const res = await setModelProvider(mode);
      setProviderMode(mode);
      if (res?.status) setModelStatus(res.status);
      setStatusMessage({ type: 'success', text: `Modalità motore impostata su: ${mode}` });
    } catch (err) {
      setStatusMessage({ type: 'error', text: err.message || 'Errore cambio provider' });
    } finally {
      setIsModelActionLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleToggleServer = async () => {
    try {
      setIsModelActionLoading(true);
      if (modelStatus?.local_model?.is_alive) {
        await stopLocalModel();
        setStatusMessage({ type: 'success', text: 'llama-server arrestato con successo.' });
      } else {
        const res = await startLocalModel(false);
        if (!res.success) {
          setStatusMessage({ type: 'error', text: res.error || 'Impossibile avviare il modello locale.' });
        } else {
          setStatusMessage({ type: 'success', text: res.message || 'Qwen3.5-4B avviato con successo!' });
        }
      }
      const updated = await getModelStatus();
      if (updated) setModelStatus(updated);
    } catch (err) {
      setStatusMessage({ type: 'error', text: err.message || 'Errore controllo server locale' });
    } finally {
      setIsModelActionLoading(false);
    }
  };

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  const handleSaveApiKey = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!apiKey.trim()) {
      setStatusMessage({ type: 'error', text: 'La chiave API non può essere vuota.' });
      return;
    }

    try {
      setIsLoading(true);
      const res = await saveApiKey(apiKey.trim());
      setStatusMessage({
        type: 'success',
        text: res.message || 'Chiave GEMINI_API_KEY salvata e client Gemini 3.8 Flash ricaricato!',
      });
    } catch (err) {
      setStatusMessage({
        type: 'error',
        text: err.message || 'Errore durante il salvataggio della chiave.',
      });
    } finally {
      setIsLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleSaveUserName = (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    const cleanName = userName.trim() || 'Costa';
    onUpdateUserName(cleanName);
    setStatusMessage({
      type: 'success',
      text: `Nome utente aggiornato a "${cleanName}".`,
    });
  };

  const handleResetDatabase = async () => {
    try {
      setIsLoading(true);
      await resetDatabase();
      setIsResetConfirmOpen(false);
      setStatusMessage({
        type: 'success',
        text: 'Database azzerato con successo! Le chat sono state pulite.',
      });
      if (onDatabaseReset) {
        onDatabaseReset();
      }
    } catch (err) {
      setStatusMessage({
        type: 'error',
        text: err.message || 'Errore durante l\'azzeramento del database.',
      });
    } finally {
      setIsLoading(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 bg-black/50 backdrop-blur-xs flex items-center justify-center p-4">
      <motion.div
        initial={{ opacity: 0, scale: 0.96, y: 8 }}
        animate={{ opacity: 1, scale: 1, y: 0 }}
        exit={{ opacity: 0, scale: 0.96, y: 8 }}
        transition={{ duration: 0.2 }}
        className="bg-white rounded-3xl w-full max-w-md shadow-2xl border border-gray-200 overflow-hidden flex flex-col"
      >
        {/* Header */}
        <div className="px-6 py-4 border-b border-gray-100 flex items-center justify-between">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <div className="w-8 h-8 rounded-xl bg-gray-100 flex items-center justify-center text-gray-700">
              <Key className="w-4 h-4 text-orange-600" />
            </div>
            <div>
              <h3 className="text-base font-bold text-gray-900">Impostazioni CoworkerOS</h3>
              <p className="text-xs text-gray-400">Modello: gemini-3.8-flash</p>
            </div>
          </div>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={onClose}
            className="w-8 h-8 rounded-full bg-gray-100 hover:bg-gray-200 flex items-center justify-center text-gray-500 hover:text-gray-900 transition"
          >
            <X className="w-4 h-4" />
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Body */}
        <div className="p-6 space-y-6 overflow-y-auto max-h-[75vh]">
          {/* Status Alert Banner */}
          {statusMessage && (
            <motion.div
              initial={{ opacity: 0, y: -4 }}
              animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
              className={`p-3 rounded-xl text-xs font-medium flex items-center gap-2 ${
                statusMessage.type === 'success'
                  ? 'bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-800 border border-emerald-200'
                  : 'bg-rose-50 text-rose-800 border border-rose-200'
              }`}
            >
              {statusMessage.type === 'success' ? (
                <Check className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-600 shrink-0" />
              ) : (
                <AlertTriangle className="w-4 h-4 text-rose-600 shrink-0" />
              )}
              <span>{statusMessage.text}</span>
            </motion.div>
          )}

          {/* SEZIONE MOTORE AI: PROVIDER E MODELLO LOCALE */}
          <div className="bg-gray-50 border border-gray-200 rounded-2xl p-4 space-y-3.5">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <Cpu className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-600" />
                <span className="text-xs font-bold text-gray-800 uppercase tracking-wider">
                  Motore di Inferenza AI
                </span>
              </div>
              <span className="text-[11px] font-semibold px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-white border border-gray-200 text-gray-700">
                {modelStatus?.active_provider || providerMode}
              </span>
            </div>

            {/* Pulsanti Modalità */}
            <div>
              <label className="text-[11px] font-medium text-gray-500 block mb-1.5">
                Modalità Operativa:
              </label>
              <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-2">
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => handleSetProvider('LOCAL')}
                  disabled={isModelActionLoading}
                  className={`py-2 px-3 rounded-xl text-xs font-semibold border transition cursor-pointer flex flex-col items-center gap-0.5 ${
                    providerMode === 'LOCAL'
                      ? 'bg-emerald-50 border-emerald-500 text-emerald-800 shadow-sm'
                      : 'bg-white border-gray-200 text-gray-600 hover:bg-gray-100'
                  }`}
                >
                  <span>LOCAL</span>
                  <span className="text-[10px] font-normal text-gray-400">Qwen 4B CPU</span>
                </button>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => handleSetProvider('AUTO')}
                  disabled={isModelActionLoading}
                  className={`py-2 px-3 rounded-xl text-xs font-semibold border transition cursor-pointer flex flex-col items-center gap-0.5 ${
                    providerMode === 'AUTO'
                      ? 'bg-indigo-50 border-indigo-500 text-indigo-800 shadow-sm'
                      : 'bg-white border-gray-200 text-gray-600 hover:bg-gray-100'
                  }`}
                >
                  <span>AUTO</span>
                  <span className="text-[10px] font-normal text-gray-400">Locale + Cloud</span>
                </button>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => handleSetProvider('CLOUD')}
                  disabled={isModelActionLoading}
                  className={`py-2 px-3 rounded-xl text-xs font-semibold border transition cursor-pointer flex flex-col items-center gap-0.5 ${
                    providerMode === 'CLOUD'
                      ? 'bg-blue-50 border-blue-500 text-blue-800 shadow-sm'
                      : 'bg-white border-gray-200 text-gray-600 hover:bg-gray-100'
                  }`}
                >
                  <span>CLOUD</span>
                  <span className="text-[10px] font-normal text-gray-400">Gemini Flash</span>
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Dettagli Qwen Locale */}
            <div className="bg-white rounded-xl border border-gray-200 p-3 text-xs space-y-2">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                <span className="font-semibold text-gray-700">Qwen3.5-4B (llama.cpp CPU):</span>
                <span className={`px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[10px] font-bold ${
                  modelStatus?.local_model?.is_alive
                    ? 'bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-800'
                    : 'bg-gray-100 text-gray-600'
                }`}>
                  {modelStatus?.local_model?.is_alive ? 'IN ESECUZIONE' : 'ARRESTATO'}
                </span>
              </div>

              <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2 text-[11px] text-gray-500">
                <div>RAM Libera: <b className="text-gray-800">{modelStatus?.ram_info?.available_gb ?? '-'} GB</b></div>
                <div>Server RSS: <b className="text-gray-800">{modelStatus?.local_model?.server_rss_mb ? `${modelStatus.local_model.server_rss_mb} MB` : '0 MB'}</b></div>
              </div>

              {modelStatus?.ram_info?.available_gb < 3.2 && (
                <div className="text-[11px] text-amber-700 bg-amber-50 p-2 rounded-lg flex items-center gap-1.5 border border-amber-200">
                  <AlertTriangle className="w-3.5 h-3.5 shrink-0 text-amber-600" />
                  <span>RAM disponibile limitata. Chiudi altre applicazioni prima di caricare il modello locale.</span>
                </div>
              )}

              <div className="pt-1 flex items-center gap-2">
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={handleToggleServer}
                  disabled={isModelActionLoading}
                  className={`flex-1 py-1.5 px-3 rounded-xl text-xs font-semibold flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 transition cursor-pointer ${
                    modelStatus?.local_model?.is_alive
                      ? 'bg-rose-50 hover:bg-rose-100 text-rose-700 border border-rose-200'
                      : 'bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-700 text-white shadow-sm'
                  }`}
                >
                  {isModelActionLoading ? (
                    <Loader2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5 animate-spin" />
                  ) : (
                    <Power className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                  )}
                  <span>{modelStatus?.local_model?.is_alive ? 'Arresta llama-server' : 'Avvia Qwen3.5-4B Locale'}</span>
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* 1. GEMINI_API_KEY Section */}
          <form onSubmit={handleSaveApiKey} className="space-y-3">
            <div>
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-1.5">
                <label className="text-xs font-semibold text-gray-700 uppercase tracking-wider flex items-center gap-1.5">
                  <Lock className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-gray-400" />
                  GEMINI_API_KEY
                </label>
                <a
                  href="https://aistudio.google.com/apikey"
                  target="_blank"
                  rel="noreferrer"
                  className="text-[11px] text-orange-600 hover:underline flex items-center gap-1"
                >
                  Ottieni chiave <ExternalLink className="w-2.5 h-2.5" />
                </a>
              </div>
              <div className="relative">
                <input
                  type="password"
                  value={apiKey}
                  onChange={(e) => setApiKey(e.target.value)}
                  placeholder="Incolla la tua chiave Google Gemini..."
                  className="w-full px-3.5 py-2.5 rounded-xl bg-gray-50 border border-gray-200 text-sm font-mono text-gray-900 focus:outline-hidden focus:bg-white focus:ring-2 focus:ring-black/10 focus:border-gray-400"
                />
              </div>
              <p className="text-[11px] text-gray-400 mt-1">
                Salvata in <code className="text-gray-600 font-mono">backend/.env</code> e ricaricata istantaneamente in memoria.
              </p>
            </div>

            <button
              type="submit"
              disabled={isLoading || !apiKey.trim()}
              className="w-full py-2.5 rounded-xl bg-gray-900 hover:bg-black disabled:bg-gray-300 text-white font-semibold text-xs transition shadow-2xs flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5"
            >
              <RefreshCw className={`w-3.5 h-3.5 ${isLoading ? 'animate-spin' : ''}`} />
              <span>Salva &amp; Ricarica Client Gemini</span>
            </button>
          </form>

          {/* 2. User Profile Section */}
          <form onSubmit={handleSaveUserName} className="space-y-3 pt-3 border-t border-gray-100">
            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-gray-700 uppercase tracking-wider mb-1.5 flex items-center gap-1.5">
                <User className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-gray-400" />
                Nome Utente
              </label>
              <div className="flex gap-2">
                <input
                  type="text"
                  value={userName}
                  onChange={(e) => setUserName(e.target.value)}
                  placeholder="Il tuo nome"
                  className="flex-1 px-3 py-2 rounded-xl bg-gray-50 border border-gray-200 text-sm text-gray-900 focus:outline-hidden focus:bg-white focus:ring-2 focus:ring-black/10 focus:border-gray-400"
                />
                <button
                  type="submit"
                  className="px-4 py-2 rounded-xl bg-gray-100 hover:bg-gray-200 text-gray-800 font-semibold text-xs transition"
                >
                  Aggiorna
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>
          </form>

          {/* 3. Database Reset Section */}
          <div className="pt-3 border-t border-gray-100 space-y-2">
            <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-gray-700 uppercase tracking-wider flex items-center gap-1.5">
              <Trash2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-rose-500" />
              Reset Database &amp; Pulisci Chat
            </label>
            <p className="text-[11px] text-gray-500 leading-relaxed">
              Elimina tutte le conversazioni e messaggi spazzatura e ripristina i 5 Coworker di base puliti.
            </p>

            {isResetConfirmOpen ? (
              <div className="p-3 bg-rose-50 border border-rose-200 rounded-xl space-y-2">
                <p className="text-xs text-rose-800 font-medium">
                  Sei sicuro di voler cancellare tutte le chat? Questa azione è irreversibile.
                </p>
                <div className="flex gap-2">
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={handleResetDatabase}
                    disabled={isLoading}
                    className="flex-1 py-1.5 rounded-lg bg-rose-600 hover:bg-rose-700 text-white font-semibold text-xs transition"
                  >
                    Sì, Cancella Tutto
                  </button>
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => setIsResetConfirmOpen(false)}
                    className="px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg bg-gray-200 hover:bg-gray-300 text-gray-700 font-medium text-xs transition"
                  >
                    Annulla
                  </button>
                </div>
              </div>
            ) : (
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setIsResetConfirmOpen(true)}
                className="w-full py-2.5 rounded-xl border border-rose-200 bg-rose-50/60 hover:bg-rose-100 text-rose-700 font-semibold text-xs transition flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5"
              >
                <Trash2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                <span>Reset Database / Pulisci Tutte le Chat</span>
              </button>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      </motion.div>
    </div>
  );
}


// === FILE: frontend\src\components\Sidebar.jsx ===

import React, { useState } from 'react';
import {
  Search,
  Plus,
  Settings,
  Bot,
  X,
  MessageSquare,
  Trash2,
} from 'lucide-react';
import BlobAvatar from './BlobAvatar';

/**
 * Fallback-safe BlobAvatar renderer
 */
const SafeBlobAvatar = ({
  shape = 'circle',
  color = '#FF5C35',
  size = 36,
  status = 'idle',
  className = '',
  showStatus = true,
}) => {
  if (!BlobAvatar) {
    return (
      <div
        className={`rounded-full flex items-center justify-center font-bold text-white text-xs shadow-xs ${className}`}
        style={{ width: size, height: size, backgroundColor: color || '#FF5C35' }}
      >
        <Bot className="w-4 h-4 text-white" />
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <BlobAvatar
      shape={shape}
      color={color}
      size={size}
      status={status}
      className={className}
      showStatus={showStatus}
    />
  );
};

/**
 * Renders avatar(s) for a conversation:
 * - Single bot avatar
 * - Overlapping cluster for multi-bot rooms
 */
const ConversationAvatarGroup = ({ conversation }) => {
  const bots = conversation?.bots || (conversation?.bot ? [conversation.bot] : []);

  if (bots.length > 1) {
    const visibleBots = bots.slice(0, 3);
    const extraCount = bots.length - visibleBots.length;

    return (
      <div className="relative flex items-center -space-x-2.5 shrink-0 pl-0.5">
        {visibleBots.map((b, idx) => (
          <div
            key={b.id || idx}
            className="rounded-full ring-2 ring-[#F8F8F7] group-hover:ring-[#EFEFEA] transition-all overflow-visible"
            style={{ zIndex: 10 - idx }}
          >
            <SafeBlobAvatar
              shape={b.shape || 'circle'}
              color={b.color || '#358BFF'}
              size={26}
              status={idx === 0 ? conversation.status || b.status : undefined}
              showStatus={idx === 0}
            />
          </div>
        ))}
        {extraCount > 0 && (
          <div
            className="w-6 h-6 rounded-full bg-gray-200 text-gray-700 font-semibold text-[10px] flex items-center justify-center ring-2 ring-[#F8F8F7] group-hover:ring-[#EFEFEA]"
            style={{ zIndex: 5 }}
          >
            +{extraCount}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    );
  }

  // Single bot conversation
  const singleBot = bots[0] || {
    shape: conversation?.shape || 'circle',
    color: conversation?.color || '#FF5C35',
    status: conversation?.status || 'idle',
  };

  return (
    <SafeBlobAvatar
      shape={singleBot.shape}
      color={singleBot.color}
      size={36}
      status={conversation.status || singleBot.status}
    />
  );
};

export default function Sidebar({
  conversations = [],
  activeId,
  onSelectConversation,
  onOpenCreateModal,
  onDeleteChat,
  onOpenSettings,
  searchQuery = '',
  setSearchQuery,
  currentUser = { name: 'Costa', role: 'Workspace Admin' },
}) {
  const [internalSearch, setInternalSearch] = useState('');
  const query = setSearchQuery ? searchQuery : internalSearch;
  const updateQuery = setSearchQuery || setInternalSearch;

  // Filter conversations by search
  const filteredConversations = conversations.filter((c) => {
    if (!query.trim()) return true;
    const nameMatch = (c.name || c.title || '').toLowerCase().includes(query.toLowerCase());
    const lastMsg = typeof c.lastMessage === 'string'
      ? c.lastMessage
      : c.lastMessage?.text || '';
    const msgMatch = lastMsg.toLowerCase().includes(query.toLowerCase());
    return nameMatch || msgMatch;
  });

  return (
    <aside className="w-[290px] min-w-[290px] bg-[#F8F8F7] border-r border-[#E5E5E2] flex flex-col h-full select-none text-gray-800">
      {/* Top Header: Traffic Lights + Unified '+' Button */}
      <div className="h-12 px-3.5 flex items-center justify-between border-b border-[#ECECE8]/60 shrink-0" style={{ WebkitAppRegion: 'drag' }}>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2" style={{ WebkitAppRegion: 'no-drag' }}>
          <span
            className="w-3 h-3 rounded-full bg-[#FF5F56] border border-black/10 inline-block cursor-pointer"
            title="Chiudi"
          />
          <span
            className="w-3 h-3 rounded-full bg-[#FFBD2E] border border-black/10 inline-block cursor-pointer"
            title="Minimizza"
          />
          <span
            className="w-3 h-3 rounded-full bg-[#27C93F] border border-black/10 inline-block cursor-pointer"
            title="Ingrandisci"
          />
        </div>

        {/* Plus Button: Opens tabbed Create Modal */}
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => onOpenCreateModal && onOpenCreateModal()}
          style={{ WebkitAppRegion: 'no-drag' }}
          className="w-7 h-7 rounded-lg flex items-center justify-center text-gray-600 hover:text-gray-900 hover:bg-[#EBEAE5] transition shadow-2xs cursor-pointer z-10"
          title="Nuova Chat o Crea Coworker"
        >
          <Plus className="w-4 h-4" />
        </button>
      </div>

      {/* Search Bar */}
      <div className="px-3 pt-2.5 pb-2">
        <div className="relative flex items-center bg-[#EBEAE5] rounded-lg px-2.5 py-1.5 transition-all focus-within:bg-white focus-within:ring-1 focus-within:ring-gray-300">
          <Search className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-gray-400 shrink-0 mr-2" />
          <input
            type="text"
            value={query}
            onChange={(e) => updateQuery(e.target.value)}
            placeholder="Cerca conversazione..."
            className="w-full bg-transparent text-sm text-gray-800 placeholder-gray-400 outline-none border-none p-0"
          />
          {query.length > 0 && (
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => updateQuery('')}
              className="text-gray-400 hover:text-gray-600 transition p-0.5"
            >
              <X className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
            </button>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Conversation List */}
      <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto px-2 py-1 space-y-1">
        {filteredConversations.length === 0 ? (
          <div className="py-8 px-4 text-center flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-2 text-gray-400">
            <MessageSquare className="w-6 h-6 stroke-1 text-gray-300" />
            <p className="text-xs">Nessuna conversazione trovata</p>
            {query && (
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => updateQuery('')}
                className="text-xs text-orange-600 hover:underline font-medium"
              >
                Pulisci ricerca
              </button>
            )}
          </div>
        ) : (
          filteredConversations.map((conv) => {
            const isActive = activeId === conv.id;
            const status = conv.status || conv.bot?.status || conv.bots?.[0]?.status;
            const isWorking = status === 'working' || status === 'typing';

            const lastMessageText =
              typeof conv.lastMessage === 'string'
                ? conv.lastMessage
                : conv.lastMessage?.text || '';

            const timeDisplay =
              conv.time ||
              (conv.updatedAt ? new Date(conv.updatedAt).toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' }) : '');

            return (
              <div
                key={conv.id}
                onClick={() => onSelectConversation && onSelectConversation(conv.id)}
                className={`group relative flex items-center gap-2.5 px-2.5 py-2.5 rounded-xl cursor-pointer transition-all duration-150 ${
                  isActive
                    ? 'bg-[#ECEBE5] shadow-xs'
                    : 'hover:bg-[#EFEFEA]'
                }`}
              >
                {/* Avatar */}
                <ConversationAvatarGroup conversation={conv} />

                {/* Details */}
                <div className="flex-1 min-w-0 flex flex-col justify-center">
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-1 mb-0.5">
                    <span className="font-medium text-gray-900 text-sm truncate">
                      {conv.name || conv.title || 'Chat'}
                    </span>
                    {timeDisplay && (
                      <span className="text-[11px] text-gray-400 shrink-0 font-normal">
                        {timeDisplay}
                      </span>
                    )}
                  </div>

                  <div className="flex items-center min-w-0">
                    {isWorking ? (
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs text-amber-600 font-medium">
                        <span className="w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-amber-500 animate-pulse shrink-0" />
                        <span className="truncate">Thinking / Working...</span>
                      </div>
                    ) : (
                      <p className="text-xs text-gray-500 truncate leading-relaxed">
                        {lastMessageText || 'Nessun messaggio'}
                      </p>
                    )}
                  </div>
                </div>

                {/* Trash Icon Button on Hover */}
                {onDeleteChat && (
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={(e) => {
                      e.stopPropagation();
                      if (window.confirm(`Sei sicuro di voler eliminare la chat "${conv.title || conv.name}"?`)) {
                        onDeleteChat(conv.id);
                      }
                    }}
                    className="opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 p-1.5 rounded-lg text-gray-400 hover:text-rose-600 hover:bg-rose-50 transition shrink-0"
                    title="Elimina conversazione"
                  >
                    <Trash2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                  </button>
                )}
              </div>
            );
          })
        )}
      </div>

      {/* Footer: User Profile + Settings Gear */}
      <div className="border-t border-[#E5E5E2] p-3 bg-[#F8F8F7] flex items-center justify-between shrink-0">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5 min-w-0">
          <div className="relative shrink-0">
            <div className="w-8 h-8 rounded-full bg-gradient-to-tr from-stone-800 to-stone-600 flex items-center justify-center text-white font-medium text-xs shadow-xs">
              {(currentUser?.name || 'C').charAt(0).toUpperCase()}
            </div>
            <span className="absolute -bottom-0.5 -right-0.5 w-2.5 h-2.5 bg-emerald-500 rounded-full ring-2 ring-[#F8F8F7]" />
          </div>

          <div className="flex flex-col min-w-0">
            <span className="text-xs font-semibold text-gray-900 truncate">
              {currentUser?.name || 'Costa'}
            </span>
            <span className="text-[10px] text-gray-500 truncate">
              {currentUser?.role || 'Admin'}
            </span>
          </div>
        </div>

        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => onOpenSettings && onOpenSettings()}
          className="w-8 h-8 rounded-lg flex items-center justify-center text-gray-500 hover:text-gray-900 hover:bg-[#EBEAE5] transition"
          title="Impostazioni (GEMINI_API_KEY, Nome, Reset)"
        >
          <Settings className="w-4 h-4" />
        </button>
      </div>
    </aside>
  );
}


// === FILE: frontend\src\services\api.js ===

/**
 * CoworkerOS Client API & Centralized Backend Connector
 * Connects securely to FastAPI backend (REST & WebSocket).
 * L'autenticazione e' mediata dal processo principale Electron (onBeforeSendHeaders)
 * e da ticket effimeri monouso per WebSocket, senza persistere segreti nel browser
 * e senza esporre credenziali persistenti negli URL.
 */

export const BACKEND_URL = 'http://127.0.0.1:8000';
export const API_BASE = `${BACKEND_URL}/api`;
export const WS_BASE = 'ws://127.0.0.1:8000/ws';

// Token in sola memoria volatile (opzionale per test, mai persistito su disco o storage)
let inMemorySessionToken = '';

export function setSessionToken(token) {
  inMemorySessionToken = token ? token.trim() : '';
}

/**
 * Returns request headers. In Electron, authorization headers are automatically
 * injected by the main process (session.defaultSession.webRequest.onBeforeSendHeaders).
 */
export async function getAuthHeaders(extraHeaders = {}) {
  const headers = {
    'Content-Type': 'application/json',
    ...extraHeaders,
  };
  if (inMemorySessionToken) {
    headers['Authorization'] = `Bearer ${inMemorySessionToken}`;
    headers['X-CoworkerOS-Token'] = inMemorySessionToken;
  }
  return headers;
}

/**
 * Wrapper for fetch with local authentication and timeout.
 */
export async function authFetch(url, options = {}, timeoutMs = 25000) {
  const headers = await getAuthHeaders(options.headers || {});
  const controller = new AbortController();
  const timeoutId = setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), timeoutMs);

  try {
    const res = await fetch(url, {
      ...options,
      headers,
      signal: controller.signal,
    });
    clearTimeout(timeoutId);
    return res;
  } catch (err) {
    clearTimeout(timeoutId);
    if (err.name === 'AbortError') {
      throw new Error(`Timeout richiesta (${Math.round(timeoutMs / 1000)}s superati). L'elaborazione locale richiede più tempo.`);
    }
    if (err.message === 'Failed to fetch' || (err instanceof TypeError)) {
      throw new Error('Impossibile connettersi al backend di CoworkerOS (127.0.0.1:8000). Il server locale è in avvio o non raggiungibile.');
    }
    throw err;
  }
}

export async function sendChatMessage({
  chatId,
  content,
  targetBotId = null,
}) {
  const res = await authFetch(`${API_BASE}/chats/${chatId}/messages`, {
    method: 'POST',
    body: JSON.stringify({
      content,
      target_bot_id: targetBotId,
    }),
  }, 180000); // 180s per concedere tempo a Qwen locale su CPU / batteria

  if (!res.ok) {
    const errData = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));
    throw new Error(errData.detail || 'Impossibile inviare il messaggio al backend.');
  }

  return await res.json();
}

/**
 * Connect to WebSocket with local authentication.
 * In Electron, headers are automatically attached by main process (onBeforeSendHeaders).
 * Alternativamente richiede un ticket effimero monouso a brevissima scadenza.
 * Nessuna credenziale persistente viene mai inserita nell'URL.
 */
export async function connectWebSocket(chatId, onMessage, onError, onClose) {
  let ws = null;
  let isClosedIntentionally = false;
  let reconnectTimeout = null;

  async function connect() {
    try {
      let ticket = null;
      if (typeof window !== 'undefined' && window.electronAPI?.getWsTicket) {
        try {
          const res = await window.electronAPI.getWsTicket();
          ticket = res?.ticket || null;
        } catch (_) {}
      }

      // Se disponibile ticket effimero monouso, usa ?ticket= (mai il token persistente master)
      const wsUrl = ticket
        ? `${WS_BASE}/${chatId}?ticket=${encodeURIComponent(ticket)}`
        : `${WS_BASE}/${chatId}`;

      ws = new WebSocket(wsUrl);

      ws.onmessage = (event) => {
        try {
          const parsed = JSON.parse(event.data);
          onMessage?.(parsed);
        } catch {
          onMessage?.(event.data);
        }
      };

      ws.onerror = (err) => {
        onError?.(err);
      };

      ws.onclose = (event) => {
        if (!isClosedIntentionally) {
          onClose?.(event);
          reconnectTimeout = setTimeout(connect, 3000);
        }
      };
    } catch (e) {
      onError?.(e);
    }
  }

  await connect();

  return {
    send: (payload) => {
      if (ws && ws.readyState === WebSocket.OPEN) {
        ws.send(typeof payload === 'string' ? payload : JSON.stringify(payload));
        return true;
      }
      return false;
    },
    close: () => {
      isClosedIntentionally = true;
      if (reconnectTimeout) clearTimeout(reconnectTimeout);
      if (ws) ws.close();
    },
  };
}

  const [tasks, setTasks] = useState([]);
  const [taskLoading, setTaskLoading] = useState(null);

  // Streaming and Tool Progress State (Fase 4)
  const [streamingMessage, setStreamingMessage] = useState(null);
  const [toolProgress, setToolProgress] = useState(null);

  // Backend Connection and Error Handlers (Fix Failed to Fetch)
  const [backendReady, setBackendReady] = useState(null);
  const [sendError, setSendError] = useState(null);

  // Test Chats Management State (Isolamento e Pulizia)
  const [testChats, setTestChats] = useState([]);
  const [showCleanupModal, setShowCleanupModal] = useState(false);
  const [selectedTestChats, setSelectedTestChats] = useState([]);
  const [cleanupLoading, setCleanupLoading] = useState(false);

  // Provider and Local Model State
  const [providerMode, setProviderMode] = useState('AUTO'); // LOCAL, CLOUD, AUTO
  const [modelStatus, setModelStatus] = useState(null);
  const [modelLoading, setModelLoading] = useState(false);
  const [modelError, setModelError] = useState(null);

  // Modals state
  const [showNewModal, setShowNewModal] = useState(false);
  const [newModalTab, setNewModalTab] = useState('chat');
  const [showSettingsModal, setShowSettingsModal] = useState(false);
  const [showInspectorModal, setShowInspectorModal] = useState(false);
  const [showAttachMenu, setShowAttachMenu] = useState(false);
  const [showMemoryModal, setShowMemoryModal] = useState(false);

  // Memories state (Fase 2B)
  const [memories, setMemories] = useState([]);
  const [memorySearch, setMemorySearch] = useState('');
  const [memoryTypeFilter, setMemoryTypeFilter] = useState('all');
  const [memorySettings, setMemorySettings] = useState({ auto_memory_enabled: true });
  const [editingMemoryId, setEditingMemoryId] = useState(null);
  const [editingMemoryContent, setEditingMemoryContent] = useState('');
  const [newMemoryContent, setNewMemoryContent] = useState('');
  const [newMemoryType, setNewMemoryType] = useState('fact');
  const [showNewMemoryForm, setShowNewMemoryForm] = useState(false);
  const [loadingMemories, setLoadingMemories] = useState(false);

  // Scheduler & Automazioni state (Fase 2C)
  const [showSchedulerModal, setShowSchedulerModal] = useState(false);
  const [schedulerTab, setSchedulerTab] = useState('jobs');
  const [scheduledJobs, setScheduledJobs] = useState([]);
  const [schedulerHistory, setSchedulerHistory] = useState([]);
  const [usageSummary, setUsageSummary] = useState({ requests_count: 0, total_tokens: 0, estimated_cost_usd: 0.0, by_model: [] });
  const [usageLimits, setUsageLimits] = useState({ max_requests_daily: 200, max_requests_per_task: 15, max_concurrent_tasks: 3 });
  const [notificationsList, setNotificationsList] = useState([]);
  const [unreadNotifCount, setUnreadNotifCount] = useState(0);
  const [loadingScheduler, setLoadingScheduler] = useState(false);

    name: '',
    prompt: '',
    schedule_type: 'interval',
    interval_seconds: 3600,
    time: '09:00',
    target_bot_id: 'chief',

    timezone: 'Europe/Rome',
    target_time: '',
  });
  const [showNewJobForm, setShowNewJobForm] = useState(false);

  // Settings & forms
  const [apiKeyInput, setApiKeyInput] = useState('');
  const [maskedKey, setMaskedKey] = useState('');
  const [maskedToken, setMaskedToken] = useState('');
  const [newChatTitle, setNewChatTitle] = useState('');
  const [selectedBotIds, setSelectedBotIds] = useState(['chief', 'architect', 'builder']);
  const [newBotName, setNewBotName] = useState('');

  // Inspector
  const [inspectorData, setInspectorData] = useState(null);
  const [inspectorWindows, setInspectorWindows] = useState([]);
  const [loadingInspector, setLoadingInspector] = useState(false);

  const messagesEndRef = useRef(null);
  const wsRef = useRef(null);
  const fileInputRef = useRef(null);

  const botsMap = useMemo(() => {
    const map = {};
    bots.forEach((b) => { map[b.id] = b; });
    return map;
  }, [bots]);

  const activeChat = useMemo(
    () => chats.find((c) => c.id === activeChatId) || chats[0] || null,
    [chats, activeChatId]
  );

  const loadTestChatsList = useCallback(async () => {
    try {
      const data = await getTestChats();
      if (data && Array.isArray(data.test_chats)) {
        setTestChats(data.test_chats);
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.warn('Failed to load test chats:', err);
    }
  }, []);

  const loadBootstrap = useCallback(async () => {
    try {
      const isHealthy = await checkBackendHealth();
      setBackendReady(isHealthy);
      if (!isHealthy) return;

      const data = await bootstrap();
      if (data) {
        if (data.bots?.length) setBots(data.bots);
        if (data.chats?.length) {
          setChats(data.chats);
          if (!data.chats.some((c) => c.id === activeChatId)) {
            setActiveChatId(data.chats[0].id);
          }
        }
        if (data.model_status) {
          setModelStatus(data.model_status);
          if (data.model_status.provider_mode) {
            setProviderMode(data.model_status.provider_mode);
          }
        }
      }
      await loadTestChatsList();
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Bootstrap error:', err);
      setBackendReady(false);
    }
  }, [activeChatId, loadTestChatsList]);

  const loadChatMessages = useCallback(async (chatId) => {
    if (!chatId) return;
    try {
      const msgs = await fetchMessages(chatId);
      setMessages(Array.isArray(msgs) ? msgs : []);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Messages error:', err);
    }
  }, []);

  const loadTasks = useCallback(async (chatId) => {
    if (!chatId) return;
    try {
      const list = await getTasks(chatId);
      setTasks(Array.isArray(list) ? list : []);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Tasks error:', err);
    }
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    loadBootstrap();
    const interval = setInterval(async () => {
      const ok = await checkBackendHealth();
      setBackendReady(ok);
      if (ok && testChats.length === 0) {
        loadTestChatsList();
      }
    }, 5000);
    return () => clearInterval(interval);
  }, [loadBootstrap, loadTestChatsList, testChats.length]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!activeChatId) return;
    loadChatMessages(activeChatId);
    loadTasks(activeChatId);

    let activeWs = null;
    let isSubscribed = true;

    async function initWs() {
      if (wsRef.current) {
        wsRef.current.close();
      }
      activeWs = await connectWebSocket(
        activeChatId,
        (payload) => {
          if (!isSubscribed) return;
          if (typeof payload === 'object') {
            if (payload.type === 'new_message' && payload.message) {
              setStreamingMessage(null);
              setToolProgress(null);
              setMessages((prev) => {
                if (prev.some((m) => m.id === payload.message.id)) return prev;
                return [...prev, payload.message];
              });
              loadBootstrap();
            } else if (payload.type === 'streaming_chunk') {
              setStreamingMessage({
                id: 'streaming-active',
                sender_id: payload.bot_id || 'chief',
                sender_name: payload.bot_name || 'Chief',
                content: payload.content || '',
              });
            } else if (payload.type === 'tool_progress') {
              setToolProgress({
                stage: payload.stage,
                tool: payload.tool,
                bot_name: payload.bot_name || 'Chief',
              });
            } else if (payload.type === 'bot_status') {
              setBotStatuses((prev) => ({
                ...prev,
                [payload.bot_id]: payload.status === 'idle' ? null : {
                  name: payload.bot_name || payload.bot_id,
                  status: payload.status,
                },
              }));
            } else if (payload.type === 'approval_resolved') {
              loadChatMessages(activeChatId);
              loadTasks(activeChatId);
            } else if (payload.type === 'task_updated') {
              loadTasks(activeChatId);
            } else if (payload.type === 'notification' && payload.notification) {
              setNotificationsList((prev) => [payload.notification, ...prev]);
              setUnreadNotifCount((prev) => prev + 1);
            }
          }
        },
        (err) => console.warn('WS error:', err),
        () => {}
      );
      wsRef.current = activeWs;
    }

    initWs();

    return () => {
      isSubscribed = false;
      if (activeWs) activeWs.close();
    };
  }, [activeChatId, loadBootstrap, loadChatMessages, loadTasks]);

  useEffect(() => {
    messagesEndRef.current?.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });
  }, [messages, botStatuses, streamingMessage, toolProgress]);

  const handleSendMessage = async (customText = null) => {
    const text = (customText !== null ? customText : inputText).trim();
    if (!text || !activeChatId || isSending) return;

    if (backendReady === false) {
      setSendError('Il backend di CoworkerOS (127.0.0.1:8000) non è ancora pronto o raggiungibile. Attendere qualche secondo e riprovare.');
      return;
    }

    setSendError(null);
    if (customText === null) setInputText('');
    setIsSending(true);

    try {
      const data = await sendChatMessage({
        chatId: activeChatId,
        content: text,
      });
      if (data.bot_replies) {
        await loadChatMessages(activeChatId);
        await loadTasks(activeChatId);
        await loadBootstrap();
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Send error:', err);
      // Ripristina il testo digitato per non perdere il messaggio dell'utente
      if (customText === null) {
        setInputText(text);
      }
      setSendError(err.message || 'Errore durante la comunicazione con il server.');
    } finally {
      setIsSending(false);
      setBotStatuses({});
    }
  };

  const handlePerformCleanup = async () => {
    if (selectedTestChats.length === 0 || cleanupLoading) return;
    setCleanupLoading(true);
    try {
      const res = await cleanupTestChats(selectedTestChats);
      if (res && res.success) {
        setShowCleanupModal(false);
        setSelectedTestChats([]);
        await loadBootstrap();
      } else {
        alert(res?.error || 'Errore durante la pulizia delle chat di test');
      }
    } catch (err) {
      alert(err.message || 'Errore durante la pulizia');
    } finally {
      setCleanupLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleApprove = async (approvalId) => {
    if (!approvalId || actionLoading) return;
    setActionLoading(approvalId);
    try {
      await approveAction(approvalId);
      await loadChatMessages(activeChatId);
      await loadTasks(activeChatId);
    } catch (err) {
      alert(err.message || 'Errore durante l\'approvazione');
    } finally {
      setActionLoading(null);
    }
  };

  const handleReject = async (approvalId) => {
    if (!approvalId || actionLoading) return;
    setActionLoading(approvalId);
    try {
      await rejectAction(approvalId);
      await loadChatMessages(activeChatId);
      await loadTasks(activeChatId);
    } catch (err) {
      alert(err.message || 'Errore durante il rifiuto');
    } finally {
      setActionLoading(null);
    }
  };

  const handleResumeTask = async (taskId) => {
    if (!taskId || taskLoading) return;
    setTaskLoading(taskId);
    try {
      await resumeTask(taskId);
      await loadTasks(activeChatId);
      await loadChatMessages(activeChatId);
    } catch (err) {
      alert(err.message || 'Errore durante la ripresa del task');
    } finally {
      setTaskLoading(null);
    }
  };

  const handleCancelTask = async (taskId) => {
    if (!taskId || taskLoading) return;
    setTaskLoading(taskId);
    try {
      await cancelTask(taskId);
      await loadTasks(activeChatId);
    } catch (err) {
      alert(err.message || 'Errore durante l\'annullamento del task');
    } finally {
      setTaskLoading(null);
    }
  };

  const openInspector = async () => {
    setShowInspectorModal(true);
    setLoadingInspector(true);
    try {
      const [capData, winJson] = await Promise.all([
        getLiveScreenshot(),
        getOpenWindows(),
      ]);
      setInspectorData(capData);
      setInspectorWindows(winJson.windows || []);
    } catch (e) {
      console.error('Inspector error:', e);
    } finally {
      setLoadingInspector(false);
    }
  };

  const openSettings = async () => {
    setShowSettingsModal(true);
    try {
      const settings = await getSettings();
      setMaskedKey(settings.masked_key || '');
      setMaskedToken(settings.masked_token || '');
    } catch (_) {}
  };

  const refreshModelStatus = useCallback(async () => {
    try {
      const data = await getModelStatus();
      if (data) {
        setModelStatus(data);
        if (data.provider_mode) {
          setProviderMode(data.provider_mode);
        }
      }
    } catch (_) {}
  }, []);

  const handleSelectProvider = async (mode) => {
    try {
      setModelLoading(true);
      setModelError(null);
      const res = await setModelProvider(mode);
      setProviderMode(mode);
      if (res?.status) {
        setModelStatus(res.status);
      } else {
        await refreshModelStatus();
      }
    } catch (err) {
      setModelError(err.message || 'Errore cambio provider');
    } finally {
      setModelLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleToggleLocalModel = async () => {
    try {
      setModelLoading(true);
      setModelError(null);
      if (modelStatus?.local_model?.is_alive) {
        await stopLocalModel();
      } else {
        const res = await startLocalModel(false);
        if (!res.success) {
          setModelError(res.error || 'Impossibile avviare il modello locale');
        }
      }
      await refreshModelStatus();
    } catch (err) {
      setModelError(err.message || 'Errore controllo modello');
    } finally {
      setModelLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const loadMemoriesList = useCallback(async (search = '', type = 'all') => {
    setLoadingMemories(true);
    try {
      const typeFilter = type === 'all' ? null : type;
      const data = await getMemories(search, null, typeFilter);
      setMemories(Array.isArray(data) ? data : []);
      const settings = await getMemorySettings();
      if (settings) setMemorySettings(settings);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Memories error:', err);
    } finally {
      setLoadingMemories(false);
    }
  }, []);

  const openMemoryModal = () => {
    setShowMemoryModal(true);
    loadMemoriesList(memorySearch, memoryTypeFilter);
  };

  const handleToggleAutoMemory = async () => {
    try {
      const updated = await saveMemorySettings({
        auto_memory_enabled: !memorySettings.auto_memory_enabled,
      });

    }
  };

  const handleCreateMemory = async () => {
    if (!newMemoryContent.trim()) return;

  };

  const handleSaveEditMemory = async (memoryId) => {
    if (!editingMemoryContent.trim()) return;
    try {
      await updateMemory(memoryId, { content: editingMemoryContent.trim() });
      setEditingMemoryId(null);
      loadMemoriesList(memorySearch, memoryTypeFilter);
    } catch (err) {
      alert(err.message || 'Errore modifica memoria');
    }
  };

  const handleDeleteMemoryItem = async (memoryId) => {
    if (!confirm('Sei sicuro di voler eliminare questa memoria?')) return;
    try {
      await deleteMemory(memoryId);
      loadMemoriesList(memorySearch, memoryTypeFilter);
    } catch (err) {
      alert(err.message || 'Errore eliminazione memoria');
    }
  };

  // SCHEDULER & AUTOMAZIONI HANDLERS (FASE 2C)
  const openSchedulerModal = async () => {
    setShowSchedulerModal(true);
    setLoadingScheduler(true);
    try {
      const [jobs, hist, usage, limits, notifs] = await Promise.all([
        getScheduledJobs(),
        getAllSchedulerHistory(),
        getUsageSummary(1),
        getUsageLimits(),
        getNotifications(false),
      ]);
      setScheduledJobs(jobs || []);
      setSchedulerHistory(hist || []);
      setUsageSummary(usage || { requests_count: 0, total_tokens: 0, estimated_cost_usd: 0.0 });
      setUsageLimits(limits || {});
      setNotificationsList(notifs || []);
      setUnreadNotifCount((notifs || []).filter((n) => !n.is_read).length);
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn('Errore caricamento scheduler:', e);
    } finally {
      setLoadingScheduler(false);
    }
  };

  const handleCreateJob = async () => {
    if (!newJobForm.name.trim() || !newJobForm.prompt.trim()) return;
    try {
      let config = {};
      if (newJobForm.schedule_type === 'interval') {
        config = { interval_seconds: parseInt(newJobForm.interval_seconds, 10) || 3600 };
      } else if (newJobForm.schedule_type === 'daily') {
        config = { time: newJobForm.time || '09:00' };
      } else if (newJobForm.schedule_type === 'weekly') {
        config = { time: newJobForm.time || '09:00', days: [0, 2, 4] };
      } else if (newJobForm.schedule_type === 'once') {
        config = { target_time: newJobForm.target_time || new Date(Date.now() + 3600000).toISOString() };
      }

      await createScheduledJob({
        name: newJobForm.name.trim(),
        prompt: newJobForm.prompt.trim(),
        schedule_type: newJobForm.schedule_type,
        schedule_config: config,
        chat_id: activeChatId || 'chat_chief',
        target_bot_id: newJobForm.target_bot_id || 'chief',
        timezone: newJobForm.timezone || 'Europe/Rome',
        missed_job_policy: newJobForm.missed_job_policy || 'skip',
      });
      setShowNewJobForm(false);
      setNewJobForm({
        name: '',
        prompt: '',
        schedule_type: 'interval',
        interval_seconds: 3600,
        time: '09:00',
        target_bot_id: 'chief',
        missed_job_policy: 'skip',
        timezone: 'Europe/Rome',
        target_time: '',
      });
      const updated = await getScheduledJobs();
      setScheduledJobs(updated || []);
    } catch (e) {
      alert(e.message || 'Errore creazione attività');
    }
  };

  const handleTogglePauseJob = async (job) => {
    try {
      const newStatus = job.status === 'paused' ? 'active' : 'paused';
      await updateScheduledJob(job.id, { status: newStatus });
      const updated = await getScheduledJobs();
      setScheduledJobs(updated || []);
    } catch (e) {
      alert(e.message || 'Errore aggiornamento');
    }
  };

  const handleDeleteJob = async (jobId) => {
    if (!confirm('Eliminare definitivamente questa attività programmata?')) return;
    try {
      await deleteScheduledJob(jobId);
      setScheduledJobs((prev) => prev.filter((j) => j.id !== jobId));
    } catch (e) {
      alert(e.message || 'Errore eliminazione');
    }
  };

  const handleRunJobNow = async (jobId) => {
    try {
      await runScheduledJobNow(jobId);
      alert('Esecuzione avviata in background!');
      const hist = await getAllSchedulerHistory();
      setSchedulerHistory(hist || []);
    } catch (e) {
      alert(e.message || 'Errore avvio');
    }
  };

  const handleSaveLimit = async (key, val) => {
    try {
      const updated = await saveUsageLimit(key, parseInt(val, 10));
      setUsageLimits(updated.limits || {});
    } catch (e) {
      alert(e.message || 'Errore salvataggio quota');
    }
  };

  const handleMarkNotifRead = async (notifId) => {
    try {
      await markNotificationRead(notifId);
      setNotificationsList((prev) => prev.map((n) => (n.id === notifId ? { ...n, is_read: 1 } : n)));
      setUnreadNotifCount((prev) => Math.max(0, prev - 1));
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn(e);
    }
  };

  const handleMarkAllNotifsRead = async () => {
    try {
      await markAllNotificationsRead();
      setNotificationsList((prev) => prev.map((n) => ({ ...n, is_read: 1 })));
      setUnreadNotifCount(0);
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn(e);
    }
  };

  const handleSaveApiKey = async () => {
    if (!apiKeyInput.trim()) return;
    try {
      await saveApiKey(apiKeyInput.trim());
      setApiKeyInput('');
      setShowSettingsModal(false);
      await loadBootstrap();
    } catch (err) {
      alert(err.message || 'Impossibile salvare la chiave');
    }
  };

  const handleResetDatabase = async () => {
    if (window.confirm('Sei sicuro di voler pulire e resettare il database e la cronologia chat?')) {
      try {
        await resetDatabase();
        await loadBootstrap();
        await loadChatMessages(activeChatId);
        setShowSettingsModal(false);
      } catch (err) {
        alert(err.message || 'Errore reset database');
      }
    }
  };

  const handleCreateChat = async () => {
    if (!newChatTitle.trim() || selectedBotIds.length === 0) return;
    try {
      const data = await apiCreateChat({
        title: newChatTitle.trim(),
        participants: selectedBotIds,
      });
      await loadBootstrap();
      if (data.chat?.id) setActiveChatId(data.chat.id);
      setNewChatTitle('');
      setShowNewModal(false);
    } catch (err) {
      alert(err.message || 'Errore creazione stanza');
    }
  };

  const handleCreateBot = async () => {
    if (!newBotName.trim() || !newBotRole.trim()) return;
    try {
      const data = await apiCreateBot({
        name: newBotName.trim(),
        role: newBotRole.trim(),
        system_prompt: newBotPrompt.trim(),
        shape: newBotShape,
        color: newBotColor,
      });
      await loadBootstrap();
      if (data.chat?.id) setActiveChatId(data.chat.id);
      setNewBotName('');
      setNewBotRole('');
      setNewBotPrompt('');
      setShowNewModal(false);
    } catch (err) {
      alert(err.message || 'Errore creazione bot');
    }
  };

  const handleDeleteChat = async (chatId, title) => {
    if (window.confirm(`Eliminare la conversazione "${title}"?`)) {
      try {
        await apiDeleteChat(chatId);
        await loadBootstrap();
      } catch (err) {
        alert(err.message || 'Errore eliminazione chat');
      }
    }
  };

  const activeWorkingBots = Object.entries(botStatuses)
    .filter(([, val]) => val !== null)
    .map(([id, val]) => ({ id, ...val }));

  const filteredChats = chats.filter((c) =>
    (c.title || '').toLowerCase().includes(searchQuery.toLowerCase())
  );

  return (
    <div className="flex h-screen w-screen overflow-hidden bg-[#FFFFFF] text-[#111827] select-none font-sans">
      {/* 1. SIDEBAR SINISTRA */}
      <aside className="w-[290px] bg-[#F8F8F7] border-r border-gray-200 flex flex-col h-full shrink-0">
        <div
          className="h-12 px-4 flex items-center justify-between border-b border-gray-200/70"
          style={{ WebkitAppRegion: 'drag' }}
        >
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2" style={{ WebkitAppRegion: 'no-drag' }}>
            <button
              onClick={() => window.electronAPI?.close?.()}
              className="w-3 h-3 rounded-full bg-[#FF5F56] hover:opacity-80 cursor-pointer"
              title="Chiudi"
            />
            <button
              onClick={() => window.electronAPI?.minimize?.()}
              className="w-3 h-3 rounded-full bg-[#FFBD2E] hover:opacity-80 cursor-pointer"
              title="Riduci a icona"
            />
            <button
              onClick={() => window.electronAPI?.maximize?.()}
              className="w-3 h-3 rounded-full bg-[#27C93F] hover:opacity-80 cursor-pointer"
              title="Ingrandisci"
            />
          </div>

          <button
            onClick={() => setShowNewModal(true)}
            style={{ WebkitAppRegion: 'no-drag' }}
            className="p-1.5 rounded-lg hover:bg-gray-200/80 text-gray-700 transition cursor-pointer z-50"
            title="Nuovo Coworker o Stanza (+)"
          >
            <Plus className="w-5 h-5" />
          </button>
        </div>

        <div className="p-3 pb-1">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 bg-gray-200/70 rounded-xl px-3 py-2">
            <Search className="w-4 h-4 text-gray-500" />
            <input
              type="text"
              value={searchQuery}
              onChange={(e) => setSearchQuery(e.target.value)}
              placeholder="Cerca conversazione..."
              className="bg-transparent text-sm w-full focus:outline-none text-gray-800"
            />
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* BANNER RILEVAZIONE E PULIZIA CHAT DI TEST */}
        {testChats.length > 0 && (
          <div className="mx-3 mb-2 p-2.5 bg-amber-50/90 border border-amber-200 rounded-2xl flex items-center justify-between shadow-xs">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 min-w-0 pr-1">
              <Trash2 className="w-4 h-4 text-amber-600 shrink-0" />
              <div className="text-[11px] leading-tight text-amber-900 truncate">
                <span className="font-bold">{testChats.length}</span> chat di test
              </div>
            </div>
            <button
              onClick={() => {
                setSelectedTestChats(testChats.map((c) => c.id));
                setShowCleanupModal(true);
              }}
              className="px-2.5 py-1 bg-amber-600 hover:bg-amber-700 text-white text-[11px] font-bold rounded-xl transition cursor-pointer shadow-xs shrink-0"
            >
              Pulisci
            </button>
          </div>
        )}

        <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto px-2 space-y-1">
          {filteredChats.map((chat) => {
            const partIds = chat.participants || ['chief'];
            const primaryBot = botsMap[partIds[0]] || { shape: 'squircle', color: '#10B981', name: chat.title };
            const isSelected = chat.id === activeChatId;
            const workingInfo = partIds.map((id) => botStatuses[id]).find(Boolean);

            return (
              <div
                key={chat.id}
                onClick={() => setActiveChatId(chat.id)}
                className={`group w-full flex items-center justify-between gap-2 p-2.5 rounded-2xl text-left transition cursor-pointer ${
                  isSelected ? 'bg-[#EBEAE6]' : 'hover:bg-gray-200/50'
                }`}
              >
                <div className="flex items-center gap-3 min-w-0 flex-1">
                  <div className="relative flex items-center shrink-0">
                    <BlobAvatar
                      shape={primaryBot.shape}
                      color={primaryBot.color}
                      size={40}
                      status={workingInfo ? 'working' : 'idle'}
                    />
                    {partIds.length > 1 && (
                      <span className="absolute -bottom-1 -right-1 bg-gray-900 text-white text-[10px] font-bold px-1.5 py-0.2 rounded-full">
                        {partIds.length}
                      </span>
                    )}
                  </div>
                  <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                      <span className="font-semibold text-sm text-gray-900 truncate">{chat.title}</span>
                    </div>
                    {workingInfo ? (
                      <p className="text-xs text-orange-600 font-medium truncate">
                        ● {workingInfo.status}
                      </p>
                    ) : (
                      <p className="text-xs text-gray-500 truncate">
                        {chat.last_message || primaryBot.role || 'Pronto ad agire'}
                      </p>
                    )}
                  </div>
                </div>

                {chats.length > 1 && (
                  <button
                    onClick={(e) => {
                      e.stopPropagation();
                      handleDeleteChat(chat.id, chat.title);
                    }}
                    className="opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 p-1 hover:bg-gray-300 rounded text-gray-400 hover:text-rose-600 transition"
                    title="Elimina chat"
                  >
                    <Trash2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                  </button>
                )}
              </div>
            );
          })}
        </div>

        <div className="p-3 border-t border-gray-200 flex items-center justify-between">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
            <div className="w-8 h-8 rounded-full bg-gray-800 text-white flex items-center justify-center text-xs font-bold">
              C
            </div>
            <div>
              <div className="text-xs font-semibold text-gray-900">Costa</div>
              <div className="text-[11px] text-emerald-600 flex items-center gap-1">
                <span className={`w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full ${modelStatus?.local_model?.is_alive ? 'bg-emerald-500' : 'bg-blue-500'}`} />
                <span className="truncate max-w-[150px]">
                  {modelStatus?.active_provider || (providerMode === 'LOCAL' ? 'Qwen3.5-4B (Local)' : 'gemini-3.8-flash')}
                </span>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
          <button
            onClick={openSettings}
            style={{ WebkitAppRegion: 'no-drag' }}
            className="p-2 rounded-xl hover:bg-gray-200 text-gray-600 cursor-pointer"
            title="Impostazioni, Sicurezza & API Key"
          >
            <Settings className="w-4 h-4" />
          </button>
        </div>
      </aside>

      {/* 2. CHAT AREA CENTRALE */}
      <main className="flex-1 flex flex-col h-full bg-white">
        <header
          className="h-14 border-b border-gray-100 pl-6 pr-36 flex items-center justify-between shrink-0"
          style={{ WebkitAppRegion: 'drag' }}
        >
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <div className="flex -space-x-2">
              {(activeChat?.participants || ['chief']).map((bid) => {
                const b = botsMap[bid] || { shape: 'circle', color: '#10B981' };
                return (
                  <div key={bid} className="ring-2 ring-white rounded-full">
                    <BlobAvatar shape={b.shape} color={b.color} size={32} />
                  </div>
                );
              })}
            </div>
            <div>
              <h2 className="font-bold text-sm text-gray-900">{activeChat?.title || 'Chief'}</h2>
              <p className="text-xs text-gray-500">
                {(activeChat?.participants || ['chief']).length} coworker attivi
                {activeWorkingBots.length > 0 && ` • ${activeWorkingBots[0].name}: ${activeWorkingBots[0].status}`}
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="flex items-center gap-2" style={{ WebkitAppRegion: 'no-drag' }}>
            {/* SELETTORE MODALITÀ PROVIDER */}
            <div className="flex items-center bg-gray-100 rounded-xl p-0.5 border border-gray-200 text-xs shadow-inner">
              <button
                onClick={() => handleSelectProvider('LOCAL')}
                disabled={modelLoading}
                className={`px-2 py-1 rounded-lg font-medium transition cursor-pointer ${
                  providerMode === 'LOCAL'
                    ? 'bg-white shadow-sm text-emerald-700 font-bold'
                    : 'text-gray-500 hover:text-gray-800'
                }`}
                title="LOCAL: utilizza esclusivamente Qwen3.5-4B su CPU locale"
              >
                LOCAL
              </button>
              <button
                onClick={() => handleSelectProvider('AUTO')}
                disabled={modelLoading}
                className={`px-2 py-1 rounded-lg font-medium transition cursor-pointer ${
                  providerMode === 'AUTO'
                    ? 'bg-white shadow-sm text-indigo-700 font-bold'
                    : 'text-gray-500 hover:text-gray-800'
                }`}
                title="AUTO: Qwen3.5-4B locale prioritario, con fallback trasparente su Gemini Cloud"
              >
                AUTO
              </button>
              <button
                onClick={() => handleSelectProvider('CLOUD')}
                disabled={modelLoading}
                className={`px-2 py-1 rounded-lg font-medium transition cursor-pointer ${
                  providerMode === 'CLOUD'
                    ? 'bg-white shadow-sm text-blue-700 font-bold'
                    : 'text-gray-500 hover:text-gray-800'
                }`}
